According to analysis the forming theory of variable pitch & groove depth & groove width screw, we found parameterized mathematical model of the type of heterotypic screw and put forward special CNC machining program. It realized CNC machining function of controlling pitch & groove depth & groove width to change synchronously, to fit requirement of all kinds of heterotypic screws in the zipper molding machine and plastic machine. And it will also offer a feasibility method to design or machining this type of heterotypic screw.

Author Keywords: Variable Pitch & Groove Depth & Groove Width Screw

articleTitle: An integrated method of CAD, CAE and multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: An integrated method of CAD, CAE and multi-objective optimization is proposed in this paper. It integrated prototype modeling, FEM analysis and optimization procedures. In this method to design a new product, only inputs and outputs need to be defined, which resembles to a black-box. In order to validate this method, design and optimization of a manipulator in a cherry-picker are developed as a case study. The objectives are extending its working scope and decreasing its cost under the constraints of enough strength, and the design variables are geometric dimensions. Multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) are applied to achieve good tradeoffs between the conflicted objectives. The results indicate that this method is more efficient than enumerative algorithms, and it could approach a precise Pareto optimal front. Therefore, this method is effective and could be applied widely in engineering applications.

articleTitle: The 3D simulation of automatic Sorting System base on 3DS Max
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Automatic sorting system is one of the key parts of the infrastructure for logistics, and the simulation has become an effective measure to solve the problem in system design. Taking the tobacco automated sorting system as an example; this paper will provide a way of visual simulation through the 3DS-MAX.

Author Keywords: Automatic Sorting System 3DS MAX 3D model 3D simulation

articleTitle: Affective experience analyse of massage chair
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the paper, focusing on the massage chair in China then doing affective experience analyse. According to the three components of product experience: aesthetic pleasure, attribution of meaning, and emotional response, using approaches such as market research, user Interview, persona, field experiment to do users' affective experience test of a typical type of massage chair which produced in China. Because of the specific of the affective experience, defying five persona hypothesis by using the approach of persona analyse. After persona hypothesis verified, building persona (a model of each typical segment). At last doing affective experience analyse of the massage chair according the definition by product experience. The way I do affective analyse can keep using in affective experience research later and designers can do further researches such as design strategy for massage chair based on conclusions of this paper.

articleTitle: Industrial design process composition based design tree
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Designers need aided resources to finish product design. During design process, designers need different resources at every design state, so it's necessary to decompose design process into separate design states. Industrial design process decomposition is researched in this paper, and design tree is brought forward to help composing design process, at last industrial design process composition model is built based on design tree.

articleTitle: A study on the user-centered interface design for virtual museums
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the recent years, the research investigated the development of the virtual museums in website and argued that it was crucial for the improvement of their usability and success of attracting more virtual visitors to centre the design process around users. The purpose of this study is to investigate the user-centered interface design process and the main design factors to evaluate the quality of interface design. Based on a small-scale survey of the leading virtual museum interfaces, the main factors involved in the interface design are identified. The user-centered approach is developed and implemented in a specific case that shows how these main factors help the interface designers accomplish and evaluate the project.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy ISODATA clustering method in product identity planning
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Product identity (PI) can form the continuity of enterprise products, and is of positive significance to the brand image. In this paper the fuzzy ISODATA clustering method is introduced to explore the way to establish product identity system based on the existing products of a company. An experimental study of financial equipments was conducted to evaluate the practicability of this method. First, appropriate product form features were selected and the values of each sample's features were acquired by semantic differential method; the initial division was given by the designers' experience, and then the result of categorization and the information of the clustering centers of each style was calculated using fuzzy ISODATA clustering method. On this basis the company's PI system including the sub-styles can be planned. The future products can be designed with continuity according to the result. The experimental study has shown a feasible and effective result.

articleTitle: A teaching model of spatial design by computer-aided design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, computer technology is integrated with education of art and design. From the view of environmental art design, the teaching method of spatial design is explored. Computer-aided design is utilized in the teaching method of spatial design for helping students enhance the abilities of comprehension and creation. The teaching model is a whole system from perception of space to creation of space; that is to say, space was taken as the main line including perception, representation, change and creation of space. In the whole process, the teaching model breaks through the traditional training model of spatial design, provided more effective, faster and more intuitionistic teaching experience for beginners by utilizing computer-aided design. The teaching model not only becomes a drawing tool but also an assistant of awareness and creation of space.

articleTitle: Triangulation of point clouds based on contact measurement system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The technique of surface reconstruction with point clouds has extensive use in surface modeling and visualization. Triangulation of point cloud data is an important method of surface reconstruction. In this paper, we analyzed the characteristics of the point cloud data obtained with contact measurement system and proposed an algorithm of triangulation. Firstly, using the chord-angular deviation criterion to reduce the original point clouds, then, The procedure of triangulation is presented that to construct the quadrangle with 4 points in contiguous 2 scanning lines, by compare the distance of diagonals and connect the two points which are near..All triangles meet the criterion of optimization. Example in this paper shows that the algorithm is efficient and easy to realize.

articleTitle: Preliminary study to ideas and methods of modern lamp form design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the social development and technical progress, people have had a new tendency to the lamps' value demands: humanization, artistry, fascination and personalization. Through the analysis to the material factors and mental factors affecting the lamp form design, we made a preliminary study to ideas and methods of modern lamp form design.

articleTitle: Analysis on eating behavior of children and exploration of dining chair design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, the requirement and market of children product is accordingly enlarging in pursuit of humanized design. How to design the product which answers for the physical and mental development of children is becoming more and more important. This paper analyzes and sums up the characteristics of eating behavior of children during early childhood as well as their cognitive characteristics by a series of methods such as in situ observation, image acquisition, detailed interviews and questionnaire survey in the point of view of developmental psychology, moreover, this paper classifies the children's dining chair and manages comparative analysis and finally brings forward the design principle of children's dining chair.

articleTitle: Research on the tactile recognition to epigraph and inscription
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Aiming at the cultural relic exhibition problem in virtual museum, the tactile rendering technology for epigraph and inscription exhibition is suggested. With the tactile display technology, one can not only see the real relic, hear explication, but also touch the cultural relic with his finger when he explores the virtual museum. The principle of the virtual tactile rendering system is illustrated, and both the tactile glove and the bar frame structure are designed too, and then the vision-tactile image process algorithms are introduced, finally, two experiments on epitaph and inscription are demonstrated. Experiments show that operators can perceive and recognize the character information on the epitaph and inscription surface with tactile technology successfully.

articleTitle: Research on interaction of pubic art in the context of new technologies
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, the new form of art expression brought by continuous development of new technology means is analysed, and the development trend of public art is researched. By the comparation and analysis of the mechanical interaction, experiential interaction and creative interaction, this paper focuses the comparation and analysis of the original form and interactive public art in the context of new technologies, and thus leads to the case and model of new interactive public art in the context of new technologies and advocates the new realm of public art: public ownership, public participation and ¿everyone is the artist¿.

articleTitle: Finite element modeling and analysis on interfacial contact temperature of gears based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The development of modern transmission design leads to scuffing becoming more serious for transmission gears. The finite element method (FEM) is proposed that can be used as the most economical and effective designing tool for predicting the gears temperature and the distribution, determining whether the tooth scuffing or not, and analyzing the thermal stress and the deformation of gears. The thermal finite element model is developed based on ANSYS simulate the heat generation process of the friction in the involute gears engagement, which includes the bulk temperature and the transient temperature (flash temperature), analyze the heat generation on the surface of gear engagement in the different parts and the moving heat loading method. Through comparing with the result in ISO, it has showed that the finite element model that gears temperature field could calculate the bulk and the transient temperature more accurately. While the moving heat load function could not only calculate the transient temperature on the gear contact surface, but also facilitate using the method to the other types of flat or curved surface the issue of finite element moving heat loading, so it has a broader significance in the practice.

articleTitle: Research of virtual cutting technology based on haptic feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper describes the composition of virtual cutting system and the process of virtual cutting. Based on triangular mesh model, some issues, such as the judgment of cutting conditions and the access to cutting path, are studied in details. With the progressive mesh subdivision algorithm and the body element subdivision method, the mesh splitting process and the formation of kerfs are discussed, and the virtual cutting effect is simulated on computer.

articleTitle: Research on structure design of scooter for children based on human factors
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Scooter is a small toy which is driven by users' feet. It's popular among children at different ages. We should take human factors into account during design process. The sizes of scooter must adapt to those of a certain age group of children. In this paper we put forward a methodology on structure design based on human factors, then we build a three dimensional parametric model of a scooter for ergonomic analysis. The parameters of scooters are determined according to the knowledge of anthropometry.

articleTitle: Exploring the methods of teaching design history
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The course of history of industrial design belongs to history courses, which is always considered as the courses people having to need more than simply repeat and strong memory on it, and teaching methods are boring and monotonous. In order to guide students in teaching, and make students have good thinking in learning, strengthen students' active consciousness, and make students play full role of learning. The purpose of this paper is putting forward some new teaching ways as the following - adopting figural teaching method, culturing analytical skills to solve practical problems, enhancing classroom interaction and using modern digital technology in teaching.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A preliminary analysis on Yi People's patterns applied to product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: FAS methodology (relational analysis)
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: FAS methodology is being developed based on different methodologies for the analysis of the relations between systems, to reach a modular design, product platform and product architecture. The base point of the FAS is a relation matrix (DSM), where different components and subsystems are involved. Through matrix algorithms, the optimal result in the selection of systems that can and must be designed from the modular design concept for platforms or products architectures, analyzing the relations between each of the individuals. Besides the use of the different developed methodologies for several authors, FAS analysis introduces a 3D representation based on the relations obtained from DSM development. This structure allows the use of different values, according to the types of relations analyzed and that are defined farther on.

articleTitle: The product calculation of linear polynomial and B-spline curve
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, we mainly discuss how to calculate the product of linear polynomial function and B-spline curve with arbitrary degree k and generally structured knot. This product calculation involves two questions, the one is how to calculate the product of parameter t and B-spline curve; the other is degree elevation of B-spline curve. Firstly, by making use of the conversion matrix between k-th B-spline bases and (k+1)-th B-spline bases, we present an approach for calculating the product of parameter t and B-spline curve. Meanwhile, we put forward a simple method for the degree elevation of B-spline curve. Further, we obtain the formula for calculating the product of linear polynomial function and a B-spline curve. At the end, we give the examples with k = 3, namely the product of linear polynomial function and cubic B-spline curve, which also show that the product calculation method in this paper easily implements.

articleTitle: A new sampling test method for maximum maintenance time of normal distribution items
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The traditional sampling test method is fit for cases that the number of sample is greater than thirty. A sample statistics is proposed for the sampling test of maximum maintenance time, which the maintenance time is normally distributed. Based on the non-central t-distribution, the distribution function of the sample statistics is deduced. And a sampling test method of maximum maintenance time is presented, which the number of sample is allowed less than thirty. The problem of the sampling test of maximum maintenance time is resolved by the method, which the maintenance time is normally distributed.

articleTitle: The rule Beauty of hidden form
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, there is a nearly inundant version in Planar composition what is called ¿ the beauty of form¿ but seldom or never has a treatise involved in the Rules of the Formal Beauty. Like the old saying goes, with the skin gone, what can the hair adhere to? As a matter of fact, none other than these rules can create this without number ¿ Significant Form¿. In a sense, it is also these rules that give impetus to the pace of the design, spreading the remarkable Beauty of the Rules.

articleTitle: The practical principles for website design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper reports the general practical design principles in website design such as color combination issue, graphics elements, fonts, etc -thus get the emotional response that you want to get from your visitors. By effectively designing the layout of website and combining all the information elements can create an attractive, user-friendly website which user can easily find the information they are hunting.

articleTitle: The modeling and aesthetic characteristics of graphic design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, the rapid development of the information media industry in the modern society makes the graphic design of characters own its powerful advantages in information transmission. It is more visualized, convenient and fast than written language on spreading information and expressing thoughts and passion. By taken the graphic design of characters as a way of design expression, this essay discusses the aesthetic characteristics in graphic design through the modeling's beauty of simplicity, association, metaphor and interest.

articleTitle: The application of decoration skills in modern textile products
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The skills of the decorative design of Household textile products have developed to the current varied methods and rich sorts. This paper analyzed skills and forms like the embroidery, nail beads, art of knot weaving, lace decoration, decorative sewing, shirring, split joint and inlay in terms of traditional skills and widely used ways nowadays. This paper discussed the specific application and aesthetic effects of different decoration skills in modern textile in order to enhance the added design value of textile products.

articleTitle: Spiral meshing synchro-drive twin-direction clutch
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The new technology in the design of a clutch product is presented in the paper. Its principle is to realize the separation and reunion of movement between the driving part and the driven part by controlling the rotary fit and separation of the screw thread pair. The relative axial movement in the rotary fit of the screw thread pair is used to control the auxiliary friction driving, establish the pre-starting of the driven part, reduce the rotating speed difference and realize buffering. When the screw thread pair is turned to the terminal position, the synchro-operation is realized, thus overcoming their own defects of the friction and jaw clutches. The experimental research of the clutch is made and the mechanic characteristic curve is given.

articleTitle: The status quo analysis of applying industrial design in equipment industry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Equipment Industry is one of the key industries in China. Through the industrial design to enhance the competitiveness of CNC equipment is lagged, resulted in low value-added of products, and impede their international competitiveness. In order to find the gap with foreign products, the situation of using industrial design in CNC equipment is analyzed and compared between domestic and foreign countries, an analysis of existing problems is made and recommendations are made.

articleTitle: Theoretical research on design DNA based on stylistic feature in industrial design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Products' stylistic features can be divided into explicit and implicit cues according to the theory of knowledge's division. Based on the theoretic frame and knowledge system of industrial design, patterns of design DNA is defined as explicit cues, implicit cues and mappings between them. The conceptual model of inheritance and variation is proposed and concept of inheritance power is defined. This paper also studied the operative mechanism of design DNA in the process of new product design. Finally, the key technologies and methods were discussed.

articleTitle: Research on interaction design of virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper attempts to focus on application method of virtual reality and take advantage of cognitive feature of virtual interface to explore animation interaction design. It aims at supplying feasible methods to realize simulation function of virtual reality and integrate the techniques required for creating digital actors and improve cognitive ability of human-machine interaction. This article describes motion technique and dynamic simulation of digital actor in animation area, and explores the problems and solutions including virtual animation in immersive virtual environments so as to validate the results ofresearch on these topics.

articleTitle: A study of spatial layout design of fishing vessels
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Fishing vessels are an industrial product for special purposes. Spatial layout design has great effects on the overall function of a fishing vessel. To make the spatial layout design reasonable, flexible and creative approaches of design are needed to divide and recreate the original space and meanwhile, it is important to coordinate the relationship between people, things, and space. In spatial layout design for a fishing vessel, it is also necessary to do a systematic study of user demand, identify the main points of the demand and find out targeted solutions. All these are in order to improve fisher folk's quality of life on sea.

articleTitle: Industrial design students oriented teaching and practice on form style cognition
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: During the teaching process, the author guided the students collecting sample images of products of various types, and conducting cognitive experiments to get 10 groups of images with high identification levels. Then author organized the students to employ focus group method to conclude the different styles' forming rules and analyze the details design of different styles, such as holes, slots, keys, printed texts and patterns, bevels, transition surface, colors, textures and so on. Therefore the students can understand the relationships between the form details and the product styles, which contributes to students' future study and practice in product design.

articleTitle: On the situation of the urban landscape and development
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, information on urban living in an urban environment, The work of fast-paced feel of tension and pressure for inspiration, Analysis of the urban landscape environment can reduce the physical and psychological pressure on people, relax, The urban landscape can lead people to take part in healthy activities, Thereby enhancing the value of the urban landscape. On this basis, Further analysis of the design of urban landscape in the West differences, different cultural backgrounds to improve the urban landscape quality of life in the city.

articleTitle: Product design strategies based on the psychological features of the aging people living in cities
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper investigated the life style of the aging people living in Hangzhou, Jiaxing and Ningbo and analyzed their consuming tendency and psychological features. Because of the declines of physiological functions and the changes in the living and working environments, negative emotions such as emptiness, loneliness, depression and selfabasement are discovered with aged people. This paper researched and concluded a product design strategy based on aged people according to their psychological features.

articleTitle: Research on on-line inspection system for moisture content of fabric based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents a method of moisture content detection from fabrics based on microwave. The moisture content of fabric fair influences efficiency and cost of produce. Thus, it is important to measure it exactly. Firstly, based on the absorbency effect of fabric with moisture about microwave, aiming at the requirement of most corporations for inspection and control of moisture content for fabric, the microwave technology is used to inspect moisture content, that is to say, a hygrometric scheme of microwave is designed. On this basis, the tested data are transmitted to the computer through data acquisition card and LabVIEW is applied to collect and process the data. Finally, the moisture content of textile is displayed on the computer screen. The factors affecting the measurement precision are analysed in this paper. The result shows that the method is feasible and can meet the requirement of manufacture.

articleTitle: Optimal design of compliant thermal-structural microactuators with geometrical nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The element-free Galerkin(EFG) method is integrated into topology optimization for designing compliant thermal-structural microactuators, with geometrical nonlinearities considered. Taking into account its more capable of capturing the natural behavior of nonlinear compliant mechanisms than the standard finite element method (FEM), the meshfree method is employed to discretize the governing equations and the bulk density field. Furthermore, the design sensitivity analysis is performed by incorporating the adjoint approach into the meshfree method. The availability of the proposed method is demonstrated by designing compliant actuators in which both linear and nonlinear modelings are considered.

articleTitle: Crowd evacuation simulation based on a hierarchy environmental model
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper had done a crowd evacuation simulation based on a hierarchical environmental model. An environment modeling software had been implemented which can be used to construct an environment model consisted of geometric level, topological level, path level and cognitive level. The environment model can provide many supports for visual effect, sensing, path planning, decision-making, and interaction et al, which turned the large scale crowd evacuation simulation into truth.

articleTitle: Intensive design of solar picnic products
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As an ideal clean energy, solar energy has been used widely in cooking applications. The shape designing and color analysis of solar picnic products are carried out in the light of the heating principle of the box-type solar cookers. The problem of the inconvenience in bringing the spices, water, and mess kit in a picnic is solved by the intensive design concept, which also help to achieve the rational allocation and use of the cabinet space of solar cookers and the purpose ¿intensive¿ and ¿portable¿.

articleTitle: The objective evaluation method for the woven fabric Softness grading
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper seeks to find a grading method for the woven fabric softness. An objective method based on the multi-mechanical properties of the fabric is provided to substitute the subjective method at the beginning of the paper, and the Kawabata evaluation system of fabric (KES-F) is provided to test the mechanical properties of the fabrics. The rest result proved that the comprehensive value M based on the mechanical properties can be used to rank the softness of the fabrics. More sample fabrics are prepared for the grading, and the softness grades of the fabrics is defined by the M value as well as the handle feeling of those fabrics. At the end of the paper, some other fabrics with different softness are provided to evaluate their grades via the equation of M, and the test result proved that the equation is reliable for the softness grading.

articleTitle: Research on the frame of text mining based on grid in the network environment
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This study proposes a novel text mining in network environment (TMN) frame on the grid, which firstly applies the grid technology to text mining system for improving the performance of TMN. The TMN system is to implement a high performance text mining process on the grid, and provide users with a high efficiency text mining and knowledge discovery services. We focus our discussion on the formulation of this frame for TMN system on the grid. In this study, firstly, a general frame of grid-based TMNN is proposed, then a main process about TMNN on the grid is described, and subsequently the implementation of the proposed grid-based TMN frame model is given. Finally, some conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Design of nonlinear control system with time delays
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Model following control system (MFCS) can output general signals following the desired ones. In this paper, a method of nonlinear model following control system will be extended to be a nonlinear system in discrete time. The nonlinear system studied in this paper has the property of norm constraint ‖ f (v(t)) ‖≤α + β‖v(t)‖<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">γ</sup>, where α≥0, β0, 0≤γ≪1. In this case, a new criterion is proposed to ensure the internal states be stable.

articleTitle: Product's visualization and human's cognition
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The products mainly refer to visual product form the basic elements; both shape, colour and material considerations, this article from the person's visual perception of the need for product shape, pointed out that the debate should be set to form the basis for innovative design to create the times people's emotional needs and products, and promote the comprehensive development of sustainable industrial design.

articleTitle: A configuration design based on knowledge reuse
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to improve the degree of design knowledge reuse and to promote the intelligence lever of product configuration, a configurable product design method is proposed, including the definition of product component based on the object-oriented ideology, the investigation for the method of product componentization and configuration design, and the case study of developing the CNC human-machine interface.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the application of traditional Chinese cultural symbols of landscape architecture in modern design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Parameterization design and motion analysis for Multi-start ZA worm gearing based on virtual processing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Archimedes worm gear's teeth surfaces are comply and their models were usually built approximately in CAD. This article analyses the processing character and formation principle of the Multi-start ZA worm, builds the accurate model and makes the full parametric design. In environment of Pro/E, applying the entire relevance character between virtual assembly and component, simulating reality processes, the worm gear was produced virtually, and its model was built accurately. Furthermore, the generated worm gear and worm were assembled virtually and their motions were simulated and analysed.

articleTitle: Use of digitized music and training of good singing psychology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Use of digitized technology in vocality class can enlighten students to use many psychology methods like feeling, sense, imagination, emotion and temperament to control and adjust the physiology skills in singing and vocalization. Use of digitized music can train students' good singing psychology and raise the teaching efficiency and teaching effect of vocality class.

articleTitle: An analysis of the relationship between the product and its packaging designing in the modern industrial designing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The rapid development and intensified market competition in today's industrial society have involved the product with more peripheral competitions other than the product's quality. Propelled by commercial interests, the product's packaging has become comparatively important and the product's added value has been fully represented. In this paper, the author will give her views in terms of the major and minor questions in the product's designing and packaging designing, including the importance of the product itself, and how to coordinate the relationship between the two in order to improve the product's core market competitive value.

articleTitle: On demonstrativeness of template design and technology teaching
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of clothing industry production, the template design and technology has marched from traditional hand-made into manufacturing production characterized by modernization and mechanization. In order to adapt to the needs of future production, the template design and technology teaching must change. Not only do we need standard basic teaching and teaching content change which is brought by new equipment and new material, but also advanced technologies such as computer technology must be introduced into teaching in order to better serve the market and clothing enterprises.

articleTitle: A study on industrial product design system based on interaction design philosophy
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Most of industrial products are developed from the perspective of engineering and manufacturing. The products according this design idea usually are with good functions, but consumers are often confused by the functions and complex operating procedures. This article presents a detailed analysis of industrial design system based on interaction design philosophy to solve the problem.

articleTitle: User research at the maturity stage of product lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Usability engineering, which is based on user research, ought to be incorporated throughout the whole lifecycle of the product. A typical user research process in the maturity period of products is described. Suggested that effectively conducting user research at the maturity stage of product lifecycle could help to improve the services and quality of existing product, maintain the user loyalty, prolong the lifecycle, and have positive impact on its sustainable development.

Index Terms: Stages Of The Product Life Cycle

articleTitle: Consideration about humanist core design of animation creation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with the personnel who engage in animation profession increase unceasingly in recent years and the unceasing development of animation education has trained a large quantities of animation talented person, these animation practitioners or the amateurs will become the representative of China animation in the future. the quality of animation personnel will directly affect the level of animation industry and animation quality. The source of animation creation should return to the humanist core ownership, any animation jobholder or animation creator neglects this basic question will be the very big failure. Animation production always should impenetrate by the design idea of humanist core, only in this way can animation really rise to a certain level, any negligence of humanist core but to stress technology will not be advisable, both should be compatible and be merged, let the works full of humanist design infect and educate the human, truly further let the new media art of animation enter into our popular field of vision, welcome the new boundary of animation understanding and spread.

articleTitle: Consumers' lifestyle research and product development
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the drastic competitions among the corporations, companies need different thinking to develop new products. The understanding of consumer groups and study of products' fuzzy front end are made use of gradually. Lifestyle, based on the consumers' life experience and value proposal plays an important role during the process of product systematic design and development. This paper will study these corresponding theories based on the consumers' life.

articleTitle: Product design semanteme expression under the digital environment
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The digitized product by its highly effective, multi-purpose, the intellectualized superiority gradually penetrate people's life, the digitization product design has been separated from the original product design concept, besides must solve the product function, the man-machine relations, the structure, the material and so on fundamental factor, even more must pay attention to the digitization product design the semantic characteristic, enables the human to carry on in the use product process with the product communicates smoothly. The digitized product's multiplex semantics expression may know and the explanation product omni-directionally for the people provides the new angle of view, simultaneously may also open the new mentality for the product innovation design.

articleTitle: The expression and application of case knowledge in CBID
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Description of the problem The study of case knowledge is the key of case-based industrial design researching. Based on the knowledge in industrial design process and the technology of Case-based Reasoning, the study is to represent the content and the expression of case knowledge in order to construct the reusing conception based on case knowledge.

articleTitle: Kcansee engineering applied in Human-Computer Interaction Design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Kansei Engineering is a method, theory and technology which research how to turn the use's kansei image of products into it's design elements. Introduceing Kansei Engineering into Human Computer Interaction Design is an attempt which establish a research community platform combined with the two disciplines from the perspective of design. It researches emotional reaction that was believed qualitative, non-quantified, non-rational and non-logical by interrelating the emotional and interactive design. It allows interactive design from the design of machine-based shift to people-oriented design, so as to achieve ¿unity one of people and object¿ideal.

articleTitle: Chinese symbols in POP fashion art
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the drive of consumer culture, mass media culture and pop culture, POP became the most influential international art trends last century. This thesis, based on author's many years' design and experience, starting from the characteristics of POP art, analyzes the innovative and practical significance in the field of contemporary fashion design, as well as in recent years the rise of the Chinese symbols in fashion design industry. It begins from the cases of fashion works, summarizes several design techniques and unscrambles the way the aesthetic characteristics of the Chinese symbols fusing into the fashion design under the influence of POP art. It merits reference for China's new generation of designers to explore ways of parting from the western blindly imitation to realize not only to accept the fashion design values of modern Western, but also to create an innovative road of design concept with Chinese characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and actualization of a new streaming media transmission method based on EMIPLIB
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Streaming media network transmission has specific QoS problems such as high package loss ratio, low throughput caused by bit error rate (BER) and transmission delay. A brand new framework based on EMIPLIB (DM media over IP library) is lodged in this article hereinafter by systemic analysis on the QoS index of streaming media. This framework, mentioned hereinbefore, preferably presents a designing concept of opening, standardization, modularization, expandability and reconstruction. The advantages of this framework, including better adaptive capacity, good transplanting features, expandability and feasibleness, can provide a transmission platform to the streaming media with assurance of QoS, and in addition, it highly simplifies the application and exploitation work. Thus, we can conclude hereby, that this framework has offered the streaming media transmission a unique scheme.

articleTitle: Educational practice in China originated from German Bauhaus—Exploration on German model of industrial design program
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: German Bauhaus had a significant influence on the modern design education, meanwhile, it established the foundation of the leading position in the world for German industrial design. Through analyzing on current industrial design conditions from different countries, art design is considered as the main part of industrial design. This paper reviewed the last 10 years' development of industrial design program in Zhejiang University of Science and Technology. The industrial design program have taken considerable achievements in many fields, such as the practice of Germany model, disciplines construction, teaching reform, manufactures & college cooperation, project teaching and design competitions.

articleTitle: The problems of network advertisements and its Countermeasures in China
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Network advertisement has developed rapidly in recent years. However, there are some problems such as lacking of innovation, distance to the acceptance psychology of audiences, vague effects assessment, and incomplete supervision and management system, etc. Therefore, it is required to make innovation on network advertisements from various angles, adopt advertisement strategies aiming at different psychology of audiences, enhance effects assessment on network advertisements and improve measures like supervision and management system for network advertisements to promote a healthy and promising development of network advertisement industry in China.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussing on the art forms
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Summary of devepment and research status on electronic low vision aids
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Low vision people refer to those whose best eyesight can only reach 0.05 to 0.3 after rectification. They can only read and write with the help of low vision aids. This paper attempts to giving a review on present available low vision aids to summarize existing problems also. Suggestions on introducing and applying usability research method will also be raised into development and research to effectually evaluate low vision aids and optimize product function.

articleTitle: Individuating of the Chinese culture in figure design of animation film
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The thesis presents how to finding Chinese design elements in Han Dynasty figure drawings and adapting them for modern Chinese animation. The revival of Chinese national animation style can be achieved by researching the figure art of the Han Dynasty with original Chinese art form, seeing through the appearance to the essence that ancient Chinese created things, extracting the quintessence of the Chinese culture from the works of figure art since the Han Dynasty, and summarizing the characters and causes of the figures. Furthermore, we can conclude the grammar of art creation and let it be the methodology of the figure imaging of animation film that accords with modern Chinese audience's aesthetic taste and national features and catches up with the time. Main research fruit of this thesis is the creation methods of Chinese individuating figure in animation film. The author tries to conclude and summarize the creation rules of Chinese figures, which can provide theories of animation figure design and support of realizing the creating techniques for animators in practical work.

articleTitle: Modeling and implementation of complicated circuit virtual maintenance system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The concept of circuit maintenance is introduced, and its characteristics and modeling requirements, especially those of complicated circuit virtual maintenance system, are analyzed. The conventional HLA-based structure of distributed virtual maintenance system is introduced, and architecture of complicated circuit virtual maintenance system is put forward based on it. The basic concepts of base object model (BOM) are presented, and the definition of BOM based modeling is analyzed in formal way. The elements in circuit BOM identified as entity type, event type, and pattern of interplay are studied based on the characteristics of circuit simulation. The entity types are distinguished as electrics component type and signal type, and are consequently described by its attributes and circuit simulation language separately, which satisfies simulation requirement and simplifies the modeling complexity. By building a complicated circuit virtual maintenance system of certain equipment, the validity and practicability of the research are proved.

articleTitle: Synthesis of four-bar straight-line linkage based on solution regions and its software development
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Synthesis of four-bar approximate straight-line linkage can produce an infinite number of solutions for given two frame points and the point which is on the expecting straight line and the direction. A new synthesizing method of four-bar linkage, based on solution region, is presented in this paper. With the method of combined programming by mixing compilation of VC++ and MATLAB, an infinite number of mechanism solutions can be expressed on a finite coordinates plane. The mechanism property graphs have been computed to enable the designers to find out the mechanism types and involved mechanism property more intuitively, and avoid aimlessness in choosing mechanisms based on analysis of solution regions, thus, the design period will be shortened.

articleTitle: Study on the application of Peking Opera sign in the creation process of character animation under semiotics
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduces the way and method which combines the traditional opera visual symbol and the zodiac character animation during the creation process of character animation. It analyzes the traditional role of the zodiac totem image and how to set its artistic image fusion, and the application and development of the visual symbol, image symbols and metaphorical symbol of Peking Opera sign in the animation. In summary, it show that the confluence of traditional art form and digital visual elements is very essential under the impact of digital visual elements and digital art is rooted in the national culture, draw the ethnic culture. To hold national cultural region characteristic and develop the traditional culture is the key to rich digital art language and correct performance of digital art form.

articleTitle: The data acquisition and processing of cabin automated monitoring and control system based on IFIX
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to the status quo of advanced industrial process control, this paper proposes to structure advanced control platform based on iFIX software. Both in the platform can do simulation research, and can also be used for the practical control process. The collection and analysis of related field data play an important role in this advanced control platform. The collection of relevant data for this cabin automated monitoring system, the key technologies of transmission and processing, as well as describes the method of report production and data import into the database system are expounded in this paper.

articleTitle: A world in a small area—Analysis of Wan an box and needle from design aspect
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Compass is a typical traditional Chinese practical artifact. In this paper, the basic structure, the design idea and the production process of the WanAn Compass are introduced. The visual patterns and design culture are carefully analyzed combine with basic principle of compass. In conclusion, the containing design concept is appraised and summarized, and its effect on modern design is analyzed.

articleTitle: Multimodal interface design based on synaesthesia effect
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Synaesthesia is the unique feeling resulting from the mutual responses of different kinds of human senses thus can enhance human ability to cognize information. The paper elaborated the concept of synaesthesia and introduced synaesthesia effect of human senses into human-machine interface design of product. By using multimodal interface based on synaesthesia human-machine interaction will become more natural and efficient. To provide a new method for multimodal interface design, the thesis explored the association between different information inputs from multiple channels and discussed the realization of multimodal human-machine interface design based on synaesthesia effect. The author also illustrated the application of this method in product interface design through a concept design of intelligent interface for household appliances.

articleTitle: Spontaneous design management
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The article discussed the product development opportunity and challenges that Chinese small and medium-sized enterprise, which mainly export light industry products, faced under the influence of the financial crisis. And after the product development environments that these enterprises faced were discussed, a mode of spontaneous design management was put forward and analysed briefly. The application of spontaneous design management not only can help the small and medium-sized enterprises pull through this recession but also help them set up big brands and good impression in the international markets. And it also can help China realize the translation from Made in China to Created in China.

articleTitle: A study on human's sensibility to agricultural machinery's color Base on SD Scale
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Base on SD Scales, the research try to find out human's sensibility to large-scale agricultural machinery's color. By dealing with data from the scales by Factor Analysis method, the study extracts two principal components of human's sensibility to agricultural machinery. Then by serving the two components as X&Y axis, an image scale of agricultural machinery' color is made, which can shows some laws of human's sensibility to agricultural machinery's color. Finally by a contrast test, the paper attempts to find whether environment will influence human's sensibilities to Agricultural Machinery's Color.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the formative arts of folk toys
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Talking about design and cultural and creative industry
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The 21st century is the century of creative design and the development of the cultural and creative industry has attracted great attention from all sectors of the society, so the key of developing of cultural and creative industry is to promote the generation of creative talent. From the basic concepts and connotations, this paper expatiates on the relationship of the concepts which is continuous. Through the analysis of the status of design and the cultural and creative industry, it carries out the rise of the cultural and creative industry needs a large number of outstanding creative talents and design play an important role in the development of the cultural and creative industry.

articleTitle: Loading path design for tube hydroforming based on fuzzy logical control and CAE method
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages of conventional optimization methods, a real-time feedback optimization method combined with fuzzy logical control and adaptive numerical simulation was proposed. Using fuzzy logical controller and defect control rules, development trend of forming defect was discovered and fed back to simulation software program in real time during the numerical simulation process, then the process parameters were adjusted to avoid occurrence of forming defect, the optimized forming loading path was obtained ultimately. Study results indicated that the hydroforming quality of T-shaped tube was improved under fuzzy logical control optimized loading path, fuzzy logical controlled optimization achieved prospective objective, and the optimization process can lead to better forming quality.

articleTitle: Virtual reality and immersion - the aesthetic experience of digital 3D ink painting
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Computer graphics imaging technology has opened up a new horizon for the development of the creative works of art and appreciation. The digital virtual 3D simulation of Chinese ink painting is more than a simple analog simulation of traditional ink painting effect, but a simulation of artistic sytle of Chinese ink painting. The digital virtual 3D simulation of ink painting beyond the traditional 2D art at the appreciation level, it combines 3D display technology of animation, virtual reality and immersive interactive technology to create an unprecedented aesthetic experience of digital 3D ink painting.

articleTitle: Normal based nonlinear subdivision scheme for surface
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper discusses a new non-linear normal based subdivision scheme for surface interpolation of triangular meshes. The limit surface is G<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> continuous, interpolating the mesh conditions (position and normal). Examples are presented, and some reconstruct sphere surface.

articleTitle: Neural network forecasting evaluation of virtual coats' profile appearance
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, experts have subjectively evaluated profile appearance of 36 garments which were made of different materials and had different ease. The coherence of experts' evaluations were tested through Friedman method. Main factors witch affected garments appearance ease were used as independent variables to establish BP neural network forecast model and multi-regression forecast model of evaluation toward garments profile appearance. It was found that neural network model was more precise than the multi-regression model.

articleTitle: Aesthetic implications of post-modern network language symbol
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As one of the overwhelmingly predominant medias in the world, network ranks the fourth after TV, radio and newspaper. Network language emerges with the development of Internet to facilitate communications via Internet. The essay aims to explore the essence of network language symbol and its impact on the aesthetic culture in modern society from such four aspects as emergence, dissemination, background and aesthetic thoughts.

articleTitle: “Microstructure” thinking in the design of the dynamic language of animation characters
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: By exploring the microstructure of the dynamic languages of animation characters, this article studies the application of the “microstructure” thinking of the dynamic languages of animation characters in design. The articulated structure of linguistic symbols of the movement of animation characters has been analyzed and the concept of symbolic space in the design of the dynamic languages of animation characters has been put forward. Based on this, the structure of the parametric relationship between symbols in the design of the dynamic languages of animation characters to obtain the design method based on the “microstructure” thinking of the dynamic languages of animation characters have been researched. This method provides a new way of thinking for symbolic design of the movement of animation characters to help improve the motion design of animation characters.

articleTitle: A fuzzy self-adjustment PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, PID Parameters are first normalized on the basis of engineering adjustment, and then are adjusted by Fuzzy control principle and fuzzy interence. A fuzzy self-adjustment PID controll algorithm is proposed. The PID Controller has the ability of adapting to such complexity and hard control object as non-lined time-varient uncertainly and on. In the end, this algorithm is applied in simulation reasearch of using over-hot system in a power plant as the object. The result shows the algorithm is of reliability and strong ablility of anti-disturbance and robustness.

articleTitle: GuiLin Tourism Image of Advertising design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper attempts to ads from the travel characteristics of the design of the starting system, with Guilin tourism market as the research object, Guilin tourism market for the design of the image ad visual montage to introduce the performance of methods to determine the application of advertising design in the feasibility of montage, for the future in order to the theme of tourism advertising in the design approach used provides a basis montage.

Author Keywords: Guilin Tourism Image Advertisement design Forms of expression Montage

articleTitle: Research on semantics of packaging design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The packaging of goods is a language which tells the customers the attributes, functions, connotation, taste and cultural meaning of products. In this paper, the basic theory of semiotics is used to interpret the semiotic meaning of packaging, and the concept of packaging semantics is put forward. First, some basic element, such as symbols, semiotics, and product semantics are discussed in brief. Then, the concept of packaging semantics is given. The connotation, structure, factors and their relationship organization also explored in depth. By researching, understanding and mastering packaging semantics, modern packaging designers will get some important guidance.

articleTitle: Computer control system for steel tower segment fabrication of Nanjing 3rd Yangtze River Bridge
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nanjing Yangtze River 3rd bridge is the first bridge that used the steel structure as the main tower in China. Because of the big size, the steel tower had to be divided to 22 segments in factory and erected segment by segment at bridge site. The shape of the steel tower can not be adjusted during erection and the fabrication error of each segment will be accumulated and propagated during erection. Accordingly, high fabrication precision of each segment was required. A variety of computer control techniques including computer aided axes determination technique, mechanical cutting platform with computer controlled reactions and 3-D shape simulation technique were used in Segment fabrication. The system has been applied successfully to the construction of Nanjing 3rd Yangtze River Bridge. In this paper, we gave the introduction of the system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The influence of zen on the gardens and landscape
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A motivation based fuzzy model for virtual human crowds
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The application of motivation psychology on crowd simulation is an interesting topic. Agents in a crowd should have motivations and behaviours, and make decisions in a certain virtual environment by themselves. A formalization of motivation is presented by fuzzy mathematical methods and a computational motivation model for agents is set up. An agent's local motion within a group is based on Helbing's model. The system is tested on an arbitrary section of a real urban and comparisons of the characteristic pasts of the test environment are correlated with the pedestrian movements.

articleTitle: Product innovative design framework based on TRIZ/FES
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Defining and resolving design conflicts are the most important aspect of product innovative design. TRIZ provides theories, methods and tools for resolving design conflicts, but is scarce in identifying conflicts. Function-effect-structure (FES) framework constructed for representing the connections of design object is an effective problems analysis way in product design. This paper presents a product innovative design process integrating TRIZ with FES. The mapping decision-making procedure for inventing the required function in FES framework may lead to opposing demands or unwanted physical phenomena within the actual system. Integrating TRIZ into FES to analyze and eliminate contradictions will bring designer to find ideal solution. This innovative design model provides designer an organized, systematic approach and efficiently shortens the problem-solving process. A practical application of this work is also presented.

articleTitle: Study on concept design system based on the whole life cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The design relation model was put forward based on the theories of concurrent design and cooperation design. The model has the attribute of concurrence, cooperation and the whole life cycle, etc. It allows designer to trigger and participate in the design process. From concept design to detailed design, designer can availably modify the design at a certain layer. The process of the product development and modeling was extensively analyzed in virtue of the principle of product innovation design. The concept of creative design PDM of mechanical products was presented in order to realize design reuse for concurrent engineering and cooperation environment. The product design process and product structure physics models are put forward aiming at this platform. Based on suitable case of design, the characteristic technique, and mapping model of product structure with PDM, mathematical model was established. The design process relation is clarified, which makes the PDM system becomes into a system to realize concept design reuse.

articleTitle: An LP model using an integrated fuzzy analysis for supplier selection problem of virtual fashion enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper is aimed at presenting a linear programming model based on fuzzy set theory. We use linguistic values to assess weights and ratings of supplier selection criteria. And then a hierarchy multiple model based on fuzzy set theory is expressed. According to the fuzzy positive-ideal solution and fuzzy negative-ideal solution, we create the linear programming model which is suited for multi- supplier selection problems of virtual fashion enterprise.

articleTitle: Research and development of the digital new media design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The development of digital technology has taken innovation into the modern art design. The process of visual art design has been simplified and accelerated through digital new media which also supplied richer forms and content carriers. Meanwhile, there is also a new requirement to modern art design with the advance of science and technology improvement. An integrated form of digital technology, art design, and new media is must be built to guide the production of new art design education.

articleTitle: Influence factor analysis of collaborative conceptual design process based on knowledge visualization
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The application of knowledge visualization in collaborative conceptual design process is a new research field. One of the most important tasks is to find the influence factors which affect this process, as well as problems it facing. This paper presents a detailed research and analysis on these factors, based on a great deal of literature analysis in areas of knowledge visualization, organization management, knowledge management and so on. First of all, 27 factors were extracted from literature analysis and expert interviews. And their weights were determined using the experimental method. And then the relationship of these factors was analyzed according to the similarity matrix algorithm. Finally, a factor model for collaborative conceptual design was proposed which clearly divided these factors into three categories, from the point view of the participants, the process control, and the environment. It helps to find out the major problems in this process and lays a good foundation for the knowledge visualization of the collaborative conceptual design. As a credible reference, it will also play an important role in the final evaluation stage of the knowledge visualization effects.

articleTitle: Feature-based design for serial products of corporation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Same style, same region, even same design team can confer the same feature to serial products from the center to the surface. The feature has been more and more recognized and accepted by the current society, how to standardize the actions of feature-based design and apply them to activities that raise the added-value of products has become important elements in modern design management.

articleTitle: Changes in perception ability of the aged and the research on countermeasure in universal design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In aging society, the capability of the aged to use products become crucial factor. Effective measures should be carried out according to the research on changes in perception ability of the aged. A safe and comfortable social environment should be provided to the age while universality of products and efficiency in using resources could also be promoted, which is crucial for the harmonious development of society.

articleTitle: A scalable product family design method based on sensitivity analysis for performance and cost
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A successful product family design should achieve two goals: minimizing the whole performance loss to satisfy customer requirements and minimizing the whole production cost to meet the enterprise benefits. The achievement of the two goals will depend on an appropriate selection of the platform, which is the key for product family design. In order to find a right platform decision criterion which can explicitly embody the two goals, this paper tries to define two metrics, performance sensitivity and cost sensitivity, to measure the two goals respectively and then explore a comprehensive metric to determine the platform. Based on this, the product variants can be optimized individually. This method can simplify the modeling and computing of product family design by decomposing the problem in an effective way. Only scalable product family design is considered and family of universal electric motors is used to demonstrate the method.

articleTitle: Ease-of-use design of elderly home medical products
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, I analysis the characteristics and demands of the elderly from the view of easy-of-use design. According to the characteristic of the home medical products, elaborates the principle of easy-of-use design of home medical products. In order to makes up for lack of concern about the old home medical products, manifest humanistic care must be through the product design.

articleTitle: Research of driver assistance system based on pervasive computing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The driver assistance system is more and more widely used with the development of automobile industry. The driver assistance system based on pervasive computing integrates the function of computing, communicating and sensing, which can assure the driving safety and prejudging the traffic emergency by sharing the information among vehicles of the same district. The structure and working principle of the system is discussed in this paper. The function of each module is introduced in detail. And the working principle is discussed to explain relationship of the modules. The research emphasis is laid on the vision enhancement technique, which involves utilizing multi-sensor information fusion to get a vision enhanced scene. And the solution of the vision enhancement system is put forward in this paper, which has been successfully used in a developing driver assistance system and got good results.

articleTitle: Industrial design method research based on multi-dimentional semantic space
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Aim to the intelligentized aid industrial design method based on product semantics, bring forwards the vague expression way of product semantics, discuss the technique to get the product semantics by tests, founds the product multidimensional semantics space and the industrial design method based on it, establish a framework of CAIDS which is based on product semantics-aided.

articleTitle: Study on the application of metaphor in modern furniture design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the market competition becoming increasingly fierce, metaphor is of vital significance to design as a ubiquitous way of emotion expression. Focused on the use of metaphorical symbol in modern furniture design from the perspective of product semantics, the paper analyzed concept, classification as well as features of metaphor design. By introducing metaphorical symbols, furniture design can not only realize product's material function but also enhance its symbolism and cultural value so as to raise its spiritual function and express emotional features of modern furniture all the better. The conclusion is illustrated using concrete design examples.

articleTitle: Analysis on nationality of Japanese Anime color
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As an independent visual language, colour is an important modelling elements and narrative means in the animation. As an independent aesthetic object, colour has a rich aesthetic symbolic meaning in Japanese aesthetics. The significant ethnic characteristics of Japanese Anime are unique in the world. The Anime designers are adept in combining deep images of traditional colour system and animation design factors perfectly, which is one of important factors that a strong ethnic style of the works forms.
