By studying deeply colours of the Japanese Anime, this passage analyses that aesthetic consciousness of traditional colours such as white, green, red and black and traditional colour aesthetic ideas influence Japanese Anime colour processing in order to discuss causes of colour nationality tendency.

articleTitle: Study on centralizer placing by wellbore 3D visualization technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: At Present, the numbers and positions of centralizers placing in rod string are decided only by the rate of the inclination angle of the wellbore. As a matter of fact, the azimuth and the movement of pumping rod make the problem more complicate. The 3D visualization technology was applied for the first time to simulate and visualize the real condition of rod strings and wellbore, in which the wellbore structure and rod strings' mechanical model were considered. According to the 3D visualization product, all positions of eccentric wear can be displayed audio-visually and the optimum numbers and positions of centralizers can be determined accordingly. The results of experimental verification for cases show that the wellbore 3D Visualization technology can be applied to design the scheme of centralizer placing in intuitional and effective manner, which provide an effective tool to work out the problem of eccentric wear.

articleTitle: The Beautiful Principles in forms reflected in the creator of the Neolithic Age, analyzing the appearing causes of the principles
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The beautiful principles in forms is what the man form in the creation of the beauty through the experiential and nonfigurative summaries of the formal principles in beauty in the process of the beauty. As early as the neolithic age, the original inhabitants have mastered the principles of formal beauty and have used in the creation activities. The principles of formal beauty through the analysis of this thesis in the neolithic age on the embodiment of the creator combined with the analysis of social conditions present, trying to explore the causes of the principles of formal beauty in the neolithic age creator.

articleTitle: Interface management for industrial design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper interface problem for industrial design is researched. Effective interface management plays an important role in success and efficiency for industrial design and innovation activity of enterprise. Industrial design is a borderline subject intersected by trans-disciplinary and grows up with the development of great industry. Industrial design just like a bond in industry society to connect interactively the subjects of aesthetics, ergonomics, marketing, creativity and technology and form them to an organic whole and translate advanced technology to commodity. The increase of interactions of the subjects should bring management questions at the same time of improving effects of study and development. Based on the intersected characteristics of industrial design, the cases such as origin of interface questions, process of information, mission and characteristics of interface management are discussed from the point of view of design-user interface, design-marketing interface, design-manufacture interface, art engineering knowledge interface and man-machine interface. Specially the knowledge interface for industrial design is discussed and researched.

articleTitle: Research on parametric design based on feature modeling and expression operation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Parametric design allows that the CAD system not only has the capabilities of interactive plotting, but also has the function of automatic drawing. Combined with expression operation, in the paper, the data structure of facade windows is firstly defined utilizing the basic principles of feature-based modeling, and then the characteristic database is built up which is used as the basis for the realization of dimension-driven of a CAD system of doors and windows. Moreover, the details of algorithm are also proposed which has fast computing speed and can satisfy the requirements of the system.

articleTitle: The application research on handwriting in China and western countries
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: There are two types of handwriting which have far-reaching effects in different areas: one is Chinese calligraphy which is used by the most people; the other is the western handwriting which is the most widely used. And they form two cultural circles. Handwriting is snubbed by designers for a time because of the convenient technology in recent art designing. The culture and strong psychological characteristics which the handwriting bears are ignored. We can understand two types of handwriting through the analysis of the characteristics of them, if so, they can be applied simply in the designing.

articleTitle: Cross-cultural language situation of industrial design in contemporary china
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese industrial design is confronted with two oppositions: one is totally westernize, copy the design mode of the West blindly, the other is pursuing ¿Sinicism¿ by putting bitty classic form into modern product. For some historical reasons, Chinese design didn't grow on the foundation of itself, but introduce from the West totally. As the result of that, Chinese design is separated whit the culture and the need of people. In this text, we will discourse how to seek the soul of Chinese culture, and how to establish the industrial design mechanism of China.

articleTitle: Website planning and design of network marketing in small and medium garment enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Since the reform and opening up in 1978, remarkable progress has been made in garment industries in China, and their core competitiveness has been transferred initial technical winning to operational management winning, and then to the current marketing winning. With rapid development and deep popularity of Internet technology and as one of marketing models, network marketing has gradually become the focus of garment industries. Through positive trial of operation in recent years, great achievements of network marketing have been accomplished in garment industries. Through research, the author discovers that network marketing in garment industries is mendacious prosperity to great extent, and there are still some aspects that are not fully up to expectations, as a result of which garment industries haven't gained due profits from network marketing. There haven't been many academic papers which start from practices and study how small and medium garment enterprises launch network marketing. Taking “Jinbai Garment Co., Ltd”, this article puts forward website planning and design program of network marketing of actual situations in Chinese small and medium garment enterprises.

articleTitle: The application analysis of visual elements in the graphic design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The graphic design is the mixture of color, text and shapes to express images, show the beauty and impart information. This article mainly discusses how to rationally apply color, text and image —the three visual elements in the graphic design— to increase the charm of graphic design, design works of jumping color, flowing text, fine image, so that it can deliver information more accurately, present ideas more impressively and communicate messages to target audience in a more effective and appealing way.

articleTitle: A new product design method based on integrated intelligence
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Recently, a lot of hybrid methods, which combine case-based reasoning (CBR) with a genetic algorithm GA, have been suggested in product designing. However, the suggested methods perform poorly in case of creative designing. In this paper, a novel simultaneous optimization method is proposed, which combine CBR and GA with an algorithm process for simulation of directed similarity association according to human being's thought models. Experimental results show that the new hybrid model outperforms other conventional approaches to creative design.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A research on the evolution path of Ming-style round-backed armchair
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Life Cycle engineering approach to track traffic vehicles
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Urban rail transportation vehicle's life cycle, at 20~30 years with repetition of maintenance and modification as a cyclic-type product is long in comparison with other products. In order to make the city rail systems friendlier to the environment, China has just begun the building of life cycle engineering of city track traffic vehicle. Some new energy saving track traffic vehicle has been developed. And a concept of cyclic-type life cycle loop of city track traffic vehicle has been proposed by the Beijing Mass Transit Railway Operation Corp. Ltd. and its rolling stock plant. According to the principle of this concept, maintenance, operation, recycling, and re-use of track traffic vehicle has been integrated. The target that makes track traffic friendlier to the environment has been partly realized.

articleTitle: Research on insulation work property of thin wall fiberglass frame member
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The text researched the insulation work of fiberglass frame when it supports in favor of temperature difference. According to the require, we designed and calculation the insulating work layer thickness size h of the fiberglass frame member. Adopting finite element analysis, we calculated the thermal field in temperature difference inside and outside the fiberglass frame member, analyzing the property of insulation work. The result demonstrates that the design is validity, satisfying operating requirement.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm for keywords extraction from documents without corpus
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm for extracting keywords without corpus is described. We use the co-occurrence information of the words and the biases of distribution to extract the more important words based on the most frequently appearing words so called reference words. Firstly, the most frequently terms are chosen from the document. Then due to keywords have a non-linear relationship with the set of frequently terms, the bias between words in documents and reference terms is measured. At last we prove that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Image separation and reconstruction for simultaneous measurement of multi-velocity field
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Simultaneous measurement of the dynamic motion of each phase in dense multiphase flow is very important to understand physically the structures of the multiphase flow. A flow visualization measurement method based on the image separation and reconstruction is proposed to measure multiple velocity fields from single-camera images. The method extends conventional PIV/PTV to measure simultaneously the flow fields of the each phase with a high accuracy in the present study. The technique have wide practical application in industrial processes.

articleTitle: Survey: Parameterized 3D human body modeling and geometric deformation technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Human figure modeling and animation has been one of the primary areas of research in computer graphics. The complexity of simulating the human body and its behavior is directly proportional to the complexity of the human body itself, and is compounded by the vast number of movements it is capable of. In this paper, a detailed survey on existing methods for human-body modeling and skin deformations is given.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive road control algorithms of Anti-lock Braking System
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Using vehicle dynamics, in this paper an automotive ABS control algorithms, which adaptive to the adhesive coefficient of road surface was proposed. And also an ABS experiment bench was explored. Simulation and experiment studies results show that this ABS system can control the wheel slip well and the control effect is good, it provides an effective method of ABS research.

articleTitle: Structural design of parallel micro-vibration platform based on three-translational mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Unlike traditional vibration platform, parallel microvibration platform can solve the problem of multi-dimensional vibration at the same time. Structural design was carried out by selecting three-translational parallel mechanism as the main mechanism, selecting flexible hinge without gap and friction as kinematical pair, and selecting reasonable piezoelectric actuator as driving component. According to the design requirements of the micro-vibration platform, by analyzing relationship between structural size and performance of flexible hinge, material and geometric dimension were chosen reasonably and the security check was carried out. Finally, vibration simulation performance was carried out by using ADAMS software, and simulation result shows that the design of micro-vibration platform is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on product formal design based on style description
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents a style description method for product form design. Designers, as designated `form-givers', are expected to understand the essence of formal styles and the skill how to give sensitive, intentional style to the artifacts they design. Firstly, this paper investigates the essence of formal style, including its definition, function, structure and components. Secondly, a style description method for product form design is proposed. This method builds on the concepts of stylistic features and formal elements. Through semantic differential analysis, factor analysis, multidimensional scaling analysis, morphological analysis etc, the relationships between each style and formal element was concluded. This issue can help designers to understand different styles deeply and to design a product customer expected.

articleTitle: The design of the dynamic language of animation characters based on dual symbols
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article focuses on the symbols of the motion of animation characters from the perspective of semiotics, and a new approach for the design of the dynamic language of animation characters has been searched. The conclusion we draw in the article is that the dynamic languages of animation characters are symbols in nature. Basically, the dual features of the dynamic language of animation characters have been analyzed: composing symbols and action symbols, and, based on the dual features, a new semiotic design for the dynamic language of animation characters has been proposed in this article. All in all, the dual features of the dynamic language of animation characters provide us with a new perspective on the design, and are favorable for the understanding of the nature of designing the motion of animation characters‥

articleTitle: The applied research of sludge materials in the automotive design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Automotive Design for automotive products enhance market competitiveness play an important role' in the entire automotive product development process occupies an important position. For automobile body design, although it is now a virtual computer technology development is very fast, but it can give a true visual and tactile, only is a physical model, and its easy to modify sludge material, molding the advantages of sludge model car has been at the forefront Body Styling irreplaceable position. Article describes the history of development of sludge model, characteristics and its production process. Through the body design of traditional and modern body design flow flow comparison, analysis of the sludge model in the importance of body design, and with computer-aided design tools in Body Design, Clay model of the status quo and development trends.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Researches on the influence of folk-custom on folk art from the perspective of door-God paintings in South Zhejiang
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A study on the developing tendency of industrial design education with national characteristic based on the theory of Bauhaus
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: China is in the reforming course of stepping into information design from industrial design. During the process, we should not only absorb the design theory and educational conception of industrial design from Bauhaus, but take into consideration the situation of our country and new phenomena arising in the reforming process, thus to form the ¿firm foundation, wide horizon¿ model in the cultivation of talents. In the process of industrial design education, we should pay attention to the cultivation of individualized design and the characteristics of nation and region, integrate the design spirit of internationalization and pluralism to form our Chinese educational system of industrial design.

articleTitle: The tendency of lamps and lanterns and the value of implementing industrial design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Closely combined with some theories, concepts, innovation and creativity of industrial designing, this essay states briefly the evolution of lamps and lanterns, discussing the future tendency of high efficient and energy-saving, integrally adjustable, small-scale, functional with decorating of lamps and lanterns, thus exploring the value of industrial design in lighting emotion, outlooks and LED development.

articleTitle: Study on construction methods of Product Identity Evaluation based on Corporate Brand Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Considering current situation and development trend of product identity evaluation investigation, based on concepts of corporate brand strategy and product identity evaluation and their relations, methods of constructing product identity evaluation system were put forward, according to the differentia evaluation of different corporate product identity and consistency evaluation of in-corporate product identity, to realize the consistency of corporate brand strategy and product identity evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on reconstructing 3D models based on an ethnic cultural model base
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Aiming to solving bottleneck problems such as modeling 3D scene and character in the process of virtual product development, this paper investigates a data-driven synthesis of geometric model, and applies to a shape-based search to find 3D models or parts in a model base, and then composite parts to form new models. Its application shows that this approach can efficiently create geometric models of the scenes and characters in cultural activities based on existing 3D models in ethnic cultural model library with regional characteristics.

articleTitle: Construction of animation specialty curriculum system for animation human resource training
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to the animation industry trends and demand situation domestic and abroad, this paper defined the training goal of animation specialty. Based on the research of the structure of animation specialty curriculum system, it considered that the structure system consists of public infrastructure courses, academic foundation courses, professional education courses, elective courses in professional education, professional development elective courses, and all different kinds of practice. It also interpreted the function of the system establishment through the specific reform proposals and the implementation effect of curriculum system.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative platform for industrial design based on PLM
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The application of computer in industrial design has become very important with the development of information technology and network technology. The computerization of design tools will change the ideology and management of industrial design inevitably. In order to solve the problem of document management, communication and knowledge management in industrial design, this paper studied the position of industrial design in product development procedure; proposed the architecture of a collaborative platform for industrial design based on product lifetime management (PLM); analyzed the key technologies of building such a platform; and built a collaborative platform with features of industrial design. The platform establishes project management templates for industrial design and design document templates based on common expression mode, solves the problem of large size model transfer, realizes online browsing of 3D model and improves the communication among designers and product data sharing. The platform helps product design overcome the limitation of time and space, shortens product lifetime cycle and enhance the ability of personalized product development. All of the above features prove that this platform has preferable practicability.

articleTitle: The impact of semantics on the product design research
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The quick development of people's life quality pushes the research of product design much more. Now besides the product function, people need the products touch them and want the design full of meaning everywhere. Therefore the theory of semantics has the chance to be expanded in the field of product design research further. Several relative areas of product design process are explored according to the semantics.

articleTitle: Constraints and consumer response in product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A good design attracts consumers to a product, communicates to them, and adds value to the product by increasing the quality of the usage experiences associated with it. This paper discusses constraints and consumer response in product design. The product design is determined by the set of goals and constraints applicable to the design project. Consumer behaviour presents response to products as comprising cognition and affect, which are followed by behaviour. Emphasis is placed on the aesthetic, semantic and symbolic aspects of cognitive response to design. The accompanying affective and behavioural responses are also discussed and the interaction between cognitive and affective response is considered. All aspects of response are presented as the final stage in a process of communication between the design team and the consumer. The good design criteria have been discussed in relation to consumer emotional responses and a selection of these has been given as examples.

articleTitle: Hardware realization of concise evolutionary algorithm on FPEA
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Traditional evolutionary algorithms require a lot of memory and processing power on embedded logic projects. Representing populations of candidate solutions through vectors of probabilities rather than sets of bit strings saves memory and processing. The concise evolutionary algorithm (CEA) is a probability vector based evolutionary algorithm. The article presents an FPEA realization of the standard concise evolutionary algorithm with a few changes to improve search power. A data flow and a block diagram design are shown and described in the paper. Results demonstrate the requirements (logical blocks) needed for realization, the architecture processing speed and the solving power of the CEA for evolutionary hardware.

articleTitle: An optimal design of adaptive genetic operation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to some shortcomings of simple genetic algorithms on prematurity and slower convergence, the paper carried through optimizing designment on simple genetic algorithms. At first, it proposed an adaptive selection operation: ultra expectation -comparation selection, adaptive crossover and mutation operation with double coordination; Then the paper proved its capability and rate of convergence by experiment. Thus, the new genetic algorithms can avoiding the phenomenon of maturating too early, keeping the multiplicity of the colony, quickening the rate of convergence. In the end, we prospected its application on the newly proposed adaptive genetic operation in the automotive appearance design.

articleTitle: “Moderate and pragmatic - the design of the establishment of a peaceful mentality”
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A look at the mentality of ordinary design, with "moderate" for the design of the degrees. The emergence of over-design, reflecting the needs of the community and tolerance, but also reflects the economic, technical support and effective, but also demonstrate the rapid development of the construction process of the loss of certain rational. Unconventional design and personality with unlimited creativity, to jointly promote the over-design. Through the analysis, deconstruction and reflection to promote a pragmatic, peaceful design, to harmony, continuity and the core values of sustainable development as a starting point, to form a normal, rational design of peace and mind.

articleTitle: Design modeling and system implementation for integral product conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Conceptual design is relative to customer requirements, ¿taking customer demand as the direction¿ has already become the dominant design concept. The framework and process model of integral conceptual design is provided, and a model of Requirement - Function - Principle - Structure is put forward. The mapping from requirement space to structure space is established by hierarchical automatic reasoning strategy, which integrating case-based reasoning, data mining tool with knowledge base, thus make the structure scheme be utmost closed to the customer's real requirement. Finally, a case study is presented to illustrate the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The leaping up schema reflected in the plastic arts of Sanxingdui Culture Relics
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on product design of parent-children product for infants aged from 0 to 3 facing to single-child parents
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper,we analyze characteristics and child-nursing views of single-children parents appeared in recent years and market requirements of parent-children products, put forward the design orientation and design principle of the parent-children product for infants aged from 0 to 3, and provide powerful guidence for the wide application of the parent-children product for infants aged from 0 to 3.

articleTitle: The cultural connotation and artistic innovation in the shinning adornments in traditional garments
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Shinning adornments, ornaments that are made of fine reflective materials in garments, are widely applied in the traditional ethical garments in all countries and are deeply fancied by all the people. Shinning adornments, as one important component of ethical garments, not only beautify and highlight the garments' character, but play an active and important role in recording, annotating, and passing down the ethical culture. The paper introduced the types of shinning adornments in ethical garments, and discussed their cultural connotations and symbolic meanings from the perspective of religion, worship, and political symbolization, and studied their exploitation and application in the current clothing industry.

articleTitle: Structure design of the anti-terror robot based on Pro/E
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The structures of the anti-terror robots, especially walking manners are analysed according to the domestic and foreign research and the application. An antiterrorist robot is designed based on Pro/E. The robot is remote operation and its appearance is streamlined. The walking manner uses eight drive wheels. Both in the normal walking and stair-climbing, eight wheels are rotated, but in different rotational speed. The design of the explosives disposal device and projectile weapons device enable the robot perform various operations such as scanning, explosives disposal and projectile. So that the robot integrates the detection, weaponry and explosive ordnance disposal. Virtual simulations of the robot are achieved on Pro/E and the results reach the design request.

articleTitle: The framework of product affection
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduces a conceptual framework for the process underlying emotional responses that result from the perception of products. The framework distinguishes different kinds of product affection on the basis of emotional psychology. Accordingly, the product affection is divided into three levels: the reflection emotional level, the basic emotional level, the emotional senior level. By revealing the characteristics of the various levels of product affective, the framework can be used to finding the inter-connected between the three levels, discovering some controllable factors in design process and constructing a “three-dimensional product affective” in the end. Expecting our research can act a small role added to the existing theory of design psychology .The model can be used to help the designer and students to grasp the mixed character of product emotions.

articleTitle: Design paradigm and its development phases
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Introducing the concept ‘paradigm’ of Kuhn, this paper brings up the concept ‘design paradigm’, then pointing out the similarities and dissimilarities between the Kuhn's paradigm and design paradigm. Thinking about the motivity of design paradigm, this paper finds that design paradigm has three phases which are agricultural design paradigm, industrial design paradigm and post-industrial design paradigm. This paper expounds the characteristics of three design paradigm in the aspect such as the relationship of ‘human—product’, design foundation, design object and the common ideology of designers. Then the paper points out that design paradigm dominates product design, discussing design paradigm dominates the design foundation, design thought and design orientation. Especially, the replacement of different design paradigm has irreversibility, the replacement of new design paradigm and old one will inevitably lead to the revolution of product design.

articleTitle: Multi-discipline fusion design of structure and process based on simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The conflict between structure design and casting process of castings has been studied to make them have good casting structure feasibility. In this paper, it takes the use of structure and process integrated design based on simulation technology to resolve the conflict. Casting structure feasibility of aluminum axle box for the high speed train application, as an example, was analyzed by this means.

articleTitle: The research of humanized design of the LED landscape lighting lamp
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with the development of LED industry, the design of LED landscape lamp is faced with great challenges and chance. It brings higher requirements for humanized design of the LED landscape lighting lamp. The article found out the current design problems of LED landscape lighting lamp, by the analysing the humanized design requirements and the humanized design strategies of the LED landscape lighting lamp were constructed according to Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs. Finally, some factors about the design of LED Landscape lighting lamp were discussed through actual case of Hangzhou Qianjiang New city landscape lighting. The goal is promoting the humanized design quality of the LED landscape and accelerating the development of the LED landscape lighting lamp design.

articleTitle: To research the life cycle assessment and sustainable development of desktop computer from a design perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with the rapid development of the computer industry environment, the contradiction between desktop computers and environments is increasingly prominent. The text analyze the whole life cycle of the desktop computer starting from the concept of sustainable development and the basic concept of life cycle. When finish the matrix of life cycle assessment method according to factors which make effect to environment in the design process, and then improve the design proposal to achieve the sustainable development of computer industry.

articleTitle: Design of beam pumping unit based on virtual prototyping technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper introduces virtual prototyping modelling technology of beam pumping unit by Pro/E software. The model is imported to ADAMS software to make kinematics and dynamics simulation; and then is imported to ANSYS software to make finite element method analysis. After optimising parts and structures by ADAMS simulation and ANSYS engineering analysis, virtual prototyping model of beam pumping unit is obtained; it provides a basis for beam pumping unit design.

articleTitle: Application of Coding system in garment Techniques design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Not only for the basic characteristics of apparel attributes, Coding system can also be adopted in the computer-aided Techniques design, and particularly play a very important role in the GST (General Sewing Time) design, it effectively links the information conversion between garment structure and its processing. Through coding of garment structure design elements, it can be more effectively determined their location and Processing sequence, what's more, according to kinds of equipment, types of work, motion analysis, processing database of structural design elements can be created. Coding techniques can effectively link parts of garment structure, processing and production line, at the same time, reach a time balance in production line through calculating standard time and rated hours of working procedures.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of CIE-Lhs color model in multi-color Effect
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Multi-color effect in Chinese painting has a special feature. To simulate its complex result of different color mixture in proportion, we introduced the calculation method of color mixture based on CIE-Lhs color model, and success to simulate the effect of pigments mixture superposition which fitting for the feeling of people through experimental analysis. Based in the method of multi-color effect, we introduce the concept of Pseudo-diffusion. The diffusion method of Pseudo-diffusion has a faster calculating speed and smaller occupancy in memory. The simulated results indicate that the color mixture effect based on CIE-Lhs color model is very lifelike in transition of brightness and saturation, and close for the realistic effect of paint mixture.

articleTitle: Information architecture and visual representation of virtual museums
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The challenge of virtual museums was to deal with a great number of museum information while the extensive integrated multimedia contents and interactive technologies enriched the representations of the virtual museum in www world. The purpose of the article is to develop an effective management of visual elements systems to visually represent the information structure of the virtual museums. On the basis of previous studies on the human visual/spatial perception, the representation of the hierarchical structure of the virtual museum can be visually transformed into spatial depth, as well as the position and proportion of visual elements. Furthermore, we referred the database technology to the visual systems to sort out five categories of visual elements in the terms of Web application technology, organizational structures of information, electronic resources, navigation systems and assistant systems for navigation. Finally, a conclusion would address the future development of the visual elements system.

articleTitle: The analyzing on design model of modern Chinese furniture based on Maslow's hierarchy of needs
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the analysis of Maslow's hierarchy of needs, the paper explored the method of product design which takes five levels of human needs as the starting point. And then combined with the dual attributes of modern Chinese furniture on industrial product and cultural product, the paper studied and proposed the design model of modern Chinese furniture based on hierarchy of needs, which can provide with cross-references to design practice.

articleTitle: Optimization design of loader steering mechanism based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the steering process of loader, the distance of left and right cylinder's stroke and arm is different. It results in the non-constant flow of hydraulic oil, which causes the pressure pulsation in the system, the vibration and shock in the course of steering' as well as energy loss in the process. So we should minimize the distance of cylinder's stroke and arm. This thesis builds the mathematical model of distance of cylinder's stroke and arm in the steering process, and makes use of MATLAB optimization toolbox to optimize, thus achieving noticeable effects.

articleTitle: Research on the usability evaluation technology of professional software interface for specific user
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Operation of professional software requires the operator mastering knowledge of profession and experiences. In order to reduce the requirements to users, the software interface needs a better human-computer interactive interface. After surveying on the process of interface design of software, evaluation index and common evaluation methods, we design a survey to investigate users' satisfaction index when users operate the software. Then analyse reliability and validity of the survey. And finally evaluate the interface usability of a profession software.

articleTitle: Innovative design of traditional educational toys based on experience design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Innovative product design based on experience design results in more personalized and emotionalized products. The design philosophies vary with different needs of different target users. By analyzing the features of Traditional Chinese educational toys, the paper proposes a new mode of innovative product design based on experience design, and by referring to and making use of the design philosophies that make foreign toys successful, points out the direction for innovative design of traditional educational toys.

articleTitle: The application of colors in series packaging design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the fierce competition of the market, the promotion effects of series packaging are increasing remarkably. The application of series packaging design draws more and more attention. While series design of packaging color is one of the most important forms of series packaging design. Series design of packaging color has a strong visual impact through batch display of similar commodities produced by same company, which is beneficial for building brand image and enhancing market competitiveness.

articleTitle: The application of design psychology in advertisement design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Starting from the consumer's needs, we consider the psychology as one of the basic idea sources of art design. The paper detailed illustrates the application of design psychology in advertisement design, and points out necessary psychological knowledge that an excellent designer should master from psychological aspect. The design psychology can optimize advertisement design and reduce blindness of design.

articleTitle: The Epochal Character of video art
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the era of reading pictures, video art is widely used as an effective form by artists and designers in artistic activities. Based on the introduction of well-known Chinese and foreign contemporary artists and their works of art images, this paper helps us aware their artistic ideas and creative practices to form our interpretation and judgment to attain a better understanding of the Epochal Character of video art.

articleTitle: Mechanism design, position analysis and simulation of a new six degree-of-freedom serial-parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, a new 6-DOF serial and parallel manipulator with a 3-rotation parallel mechanism and a 3-DOF serial manipulator ( two-prismatic plus one-revolute) is synthesized and investigated according to the theories of the structure synthesis of robot mechanisms. It is able to perform spatial transformational movement, rotation, hoisting, tilting, planar rotation and tilted rotation. The mechanism is analyzed, its kinematic position equations are developed, inverse and forward kinematics of its fine tuning structure have been focused. Kinematic simulation with ADMAS is conducted, which verified the correctness of the design, also an application case of this serial-parallel mechanism is provided. The mechanism features high workspace volume, rotational flexibility, stable balance, precision and load capacity, and can be extended to agricultural planting and picking, lumber machines and other areas.

articleTitle: The forms of books and the epochal characteristics of aesthetic appreciation for it
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Books are the carrier of human civilization. The physical combination pattern and procedures of the patterns of books reflect the responding social consciousness. The form of books evolves with advancement of times, development of science and technology and updates of people's ideas and thoughts. History and civilization have left us tremendous and varied cultural heritage that can be enjoyed by us, the later generation. We can fully feel the past generations' thoughts and passion at their time, and learn about the culture, ideology and spirit at their time.

articleTitle: A research on the design of the cartoon toys based on the analysis of the characters in the cartoon
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: China is the biggest workshop of toys instead of a country designs those, and it is the biggest consumer country of the cartoon instead of a country exports that. Facing the excellent foreign cartoon films rush into China, the Chinese enterprises that produce the toys are still in the initial stage. Meanwhile, the cartoon toys of the domestic cartoon can't get the confirmation of the market. Therefore, we should fully realize the relevance between the design of the toys and the animation industry. What's more, the cartoon toys and the cartoon do not exist alone in the animation industry, but closely relate to each other and promote each other. The cartoon toys through cartoon, the rolling advertisement, gain larger market share, and they make the cartoon more popular among the public. While the cartoon toys copy and manufacture the characters in the cartoon and blur the background, the designers should pay attention to the characters in the cartoon, plan and design the toys after the research so as to let the characters vivid and the toys acceptable, and let the model can be produced in the factory in large number. Therefore, the development of the cartoon toys should focus on the roles and develop in the same step with or faster than the cartoon. Both of these should be developed after the fully investigation of the market based on the requirement of the consuming body. This could activate the present cartoon toys design and the development of the cartoon which have already fallen behind.

articleTitle: Surface deformation of virtual human technology based on interpolation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Three-dimensional fitting technology based on internet is growing rapidly. Interpolation algorithm based on the deformation of the body surface has better efficiency and algorithms. It is an effective means to solve the problem of deformation of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">human body model</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on lamp-house design method of LED based on modular idea
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article summarized the existence questions of lamps taking LED as the lamp-house, and proposed the plan of LED crystal grain base modulation, and then carried on a series of lamp-house design in LED by this, which provided the strong function, energy conservation and environmental protection product for consumers.

articleTitle: Testing and debugging for main control valve applied in the hydraulic excavator
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The company of excavator hydraulic components will provide universal components, valves for example. But the opening throttle area cannot suitable completely for all design requirements of the excavator. To the whole machine manufacturer, even if the excavator in the same weight may require individual parameters because of the different factors, such as the working device, pump, or engine. As a result, it is necessary to have test and debug some parameters to adept the target machine. To the hydraulic components, it may have a better cooperation with the whole machine after a little change of tiny parameters. A good energy saving effect and high manipulative performance may get.

articleTitle: The application research of the RBF network on computer-aided creative design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The two-level synthetical evaluating model is presented in this paper based on the factors of substance and people which affect the industrial product model design and the fuzzy feature existed in the mobile phone model evaluation. And a synthetical evaluation system is formed as to mobile phone by the way of the radial basis function neural network. And it gained a good result from evaluating. Experimental results show that it has higher precision and quite good dependability. It not only provides the train of thought and the improving foundation for the designer, ensures the designing quality but also raises the designing efficiency.

articleTitle: Return to the tradition: DIY design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: DIY is the personal hand-made modern design fashion. It comes from the people's boredom of the modern similar products and the design instinct. It have experienced in the course of development in history of human design. In a way, DIY always is the existing form of traditional handcrafts. However, the current situation is that traditional handcrafts disappeared gradually, DIY developed rapidly. By analyzing the characteristics of DIY and traditional handcrafts such as personality, uniqueness, manual traces, this article find out the possibility of combination of the two design modes in modern society, and explore the effective ways to combine: simplification, modernization, education, and industrialization. These routes can make traditional handcrafts in the form of DIY continue and provide rich design resources and a broader space for its development.

articleTitle: The study on the training mode of application-oriented design talents in German industry
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As one of the important countries of industrial design in the world, Germany has developed a unique training mode of application-oriented design talents basic on its own characteristics. The mode provides Germany the continuous resource of excellent designers who offer first-class design service to domestic products and secure the position of “Made-in-Germany” in the world. This paper plans to analyze this training mode of talent and dig out useful points for the reference of college education of industrial design in China in order to further enhance the teaching quality of industrial design.

articleTitle: Ambient occlusion in screen-space for mesostructure objects
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the traditional ambient occlusion algorithm for microstructures, the determination of occlusion is a time-consuming task. To improve the rendering speed, the paper proposes a screen-based ambient occlusion method. By using off-screen technique, only the visible points are used to determine the occlusion. Using the depth texture of the whole scene, the size of ambient occlusion can be quickly computed by the maximum of the block angle. The whole scene can be rendered using the deferred shading technology. Experimental results show that our method is more efficient than the available methods on computing the ambient occlusion. It does not need any pre-processing, and the time used for ambient occlusion determination is less than other methods.

articleTitle: Technology and art of product display and animation system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: After entering the information technology era, the product displaying the animation technology has already been in a period of leap-forward development. The rapid development of this technology arises from the diverse scientific and cultural system. The clarification of the relationship between the digital technology and cultural aesthetics involved in the video animation was done in this paper in terms of the product displaying the animation technology, with the exploration on obtaining the aesthetic approaches to the product displaying the animation technology through the three-dimensional technology and post-editing technology. The importance of the aesthetic cultural awareness in the development of the product displaying the animation technology is illustrated, with the proposals of the new thinking, new perspectives and new approaches for the transcendence and integration from the field of digital virtual technology to the field of aesthetic culture in the product displaying the animation.

articleTitle: Improved motion estimation algorithm based on ME-Skip
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on ME-Skip algorithm proposed by H.S.Kang, an advanced motion estimation algorithm is presented to improve the real-time compression capability of H.264. The algorithm utilizes Zero-Block Detection theory to improve the skip macroblocks calculation of ME-Skip algorithm, which reduces the computing complexity. In the algorithm, non-skip macroblocks are divided into three motion types: slow motion, moderate motion and fast motion. Different motion type will be processed by different corresponding motion estimation algorithm. Experimental result shows that our advanced algorithm reduces the complexity of motion estimation, particularly the compression efficiency is higher in the slow motion of video sequence.

articleTitle: A novel training method for the Structured Language Frame based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The Structured Language Frame aims at making a prediction of the next word in a given word string by making a syntactical analysis of the preceding words. However, it faces the data sparseness problem because of the large dimensionality and diversity of the information available in the syntactic parses. In previous work [1, 2], we proposed using neural network frames for the SLF. The neural network frame is better suited to tackle the data sparseness problem and its use gave significant improvements in perplexity and word error rate over the baseline SLF. In this paper we present a new method of training the neural net based SLF. The presented procedure makes use of the partial parses hypothesized by the SLF itsef and is more expensive than the approximate training method used in previous work. Experiments with the new training method on the UPenn and WSJ corpora show significant reductions in perplexity and word error rate, achieving the lowest published results for the given corpora.

articleTitle: A lesson from present industry contrarian economic indicator for OEMs
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The world financial crisis and economic downturn severely impact on Chinese coastal areas' economy. In addition to the adverse surrounding environment, the OEMs face the foreign motherboard manufacturers' holding core technology. That causes many OEMs mire in difficulty - sharp reduce of purchase order and even bankrupt, the time of economic prosperity has gone away. However, accurate market position, user-friendly function, novel-attractive showing, personalized design whereby, the present industry broke a new path. In the first quarter this year, its industrial output value had not fallen, but an increasing level as compared to the same period of last year. It is an issue for OEMs in other fields to ponder over and lesson to take.

articleTitle: On integral design of special souvenir in sichuan earthquake area
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Economics, culture, environment, etc. all received a series of serious damage due to the earthquake on 12-05-2008 in Sichuan. This areas with abundant different ethnic culture and attractive landscapes, is badly affected by earthquakes. So everything needs rebuilding including the tourism. Rebuilding is hard work for all of elements had changed after 5,12 Earthquake and focusing on these changes, a series of exceptive souvenirs design can benefit touristic market rebuilding and improving, and it is important to exchange diversity ethnic culture and promote humanitarianism.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A brief analysis of the cultural phenomena reflected by the furniture of Ming & Qing dynasties and its impact
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Ergonomics analysis on tower fans design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the theory and methods of ergonomics, The Human factors such as shape, button, information indicating, the functional arrangement, color and material of small household electrical appliances-Media FS60-6AR landing tower fans were deeply analysed and studied, the study explained that design of their own should be in accordance with the relevant requirements of ergonomics. In the finally, raise the inadequate factors and solution to the problem.

articleTitle: World material cultural heritage fujian tulou digital inherit and transmission study
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Let the idea of “ensoul and vitalization” of animation and animation technology into inherit and transmission of material cultural heritage, to give fresh vitality of these cultural heritage, provide an opportunity that for the creation of new culture and values in the traditional culture basis. Effectively bring into play charm of animation art in transmit traditional cultural, and by exploit modern means of digital material heritage refreshing display in front of the world, to promote the material heritage the survival and development in the information age. “Fujian Tulou” constructed of 46 building by the Yongding, Nanjing, Huaan “six groups and four pavilions”. Fujian Tulou is one of the world's only large-scale residential constructions unique, large-scale, structures clever, with rich cultural connotation and unique way of living, reasonable layout and integration with the natural environment has been the location of the concept of the world. The Paper presentation on how to take advantage of 3D demo animation, virtual reality presentation system, “animation” and other forms of intervention to build a mutual promotion and development cycle of the digital transmission chain to an effective transmission of such construction in Fujian Tulou vector has a long history and culture of the Hakka and Taiwanese.

articleTitle: Research of distributed virtual-reality scene based on Java3D technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: It is a research hotspot to construct a distributed, multi-users shared 3D virtual environment on the internet. In this way, multiple users in different geographical regions will share a real-time interactive virtual environment through internet in simultaneous. Based on VRML and Java3D technology, this paper proposes an interactive means which constructs distributed 3D virtual environment, as well as a synchronization solution between the scene environment and user state. The means also gives a good guide to resolve existing problems in current distributed 3D virtual technology.

articleTitle: A social network service-oriented architecture for mass customization
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In recent years, social network service (SNS) began to flourish as a business component. A service architecture integrating SNS component with Internet based mass customization (MC) platform has been a new trend in the fields of MC. This paper is to explain the logic of the cause of SNS-oriented architecture for mass customization on the basis of Internet technologies (IMC), describe the details of architecture and how to apply it in MC business by means of some typical case study.

articleTitle: An enhanced multicriteria decision-making method of machine design schemes under interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy environment
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Method for ranking interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers is of key duty to multicriteria decision-making. Existing ranking methods using score function and accuracy function can not give sufficient information about alternatives and will demonstrate the situation of difficult decision or wrong decision in some cases. In this paper, a deviation function, considering the variance of the hesitancy degree of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IVIFSs), is presented to overcome the situation of difficult decision of existing accuracy functions to the alternatives in some cases. A method for ranking interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers is then established based on the score function, accuracy function and deviation function. Finally, an enhanced multicriteria decision-making method base on Interval-valued Intuitionistic fuzzy sets is provided and is successfully applied to decision-making of machine design schemes.

articleTitle: On the mathematical aesthetic in traditional Chinese art
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The mathematical rhythm is a worldwide artistic language. In this study, many Mathematical rhythms existing in traditional Chinese art are analysed, including lines, proportion, symmetry, infinity, cycle and numbers. The integration of classical Chinese art and mathematical rhythms makes the art presents a unique beauty—the mathematical aesthetic, which reveals the rational and scientific thinking of Chinese ancestors. This may lead inspiration in modern design.

articleTitle: Study on multi-dimensional disassembly planning strategy based on disassembly hive
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Disassembly hive is a kind of model expressing topological relationships of adjacent parts in disassembly body, which reflects the integration module between parts, as well as the feasibility after the integration. Expressing the disassembly process with disassembly hive in different dimensions and different disassembly planes and comparing their movement feasibility will provide better solutions to the exponential explosion brought by simple algorithm; improve the efficiency of path planning. Modularization properties of disassembly hive makes the disassembly process hierarchical, intelligent and avoid a great deal of calculation.

articleTitle: Material application and innovation in furniture design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article analyzes different materials used in the furniture in different times. It discusses the material style in modern furniture from two aspects of traditional material and modern material, and points out the important meaning and effect brought by industrial designers to furniture design.

articleTitle: TUI interactive product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper analyzes ¿Affordance¿ in Human-Computer Interaction design and stresses the idea of interdependency between the environment (object) and its user. The paper introduces TUI (Tangible User Interface) into interactive product design methods attempting to break the barrier set up by the traditional GUI metaphor. Finally through an TUI interactive product design which translates the abstract action of moving digital data into a tangible physical representation - using an eyedropper to pick up liquids, the paper elaborates the way easier for the user to understand through a much more natural and efficient interaction method.

articleTitle: Design paradigm and its development phases
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Introducing the concept ‘paradigm’ of Kuhn, this paper brings up the concept ‘design paradigm’, then pointing out the similarities and dissimilarities between the Kuhn's paradigm and design paradigm. Thinking about the motivity of design paradigm, this paper finds that design paradigm has three phases which are agricultural design paradigm, industrial design paradigm and post-industrial design paradigm. This paper expounds the characteristics of three design paradigm in the aspect such as the relationship of ‘human—product’, design foundation, design object and the common ideology of designers. Then the paper points out that design paradigm dominates product design, discussing design paradigm dominates the design foundation, design thought and design orientation. Especially, the replacement of different design paradigm has irreversibility, the replacement of new design paradigm and old one will inevitably lead to the revolution of product design.

articleTitle: The light models the fresh shed color to make the ingenuity to occupy
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The human life live ins public with the nature space, individual and point of intersection of space district. Conceive the life, life in the environment to bear in the environment. Along with the social market economy of the development, indoors space have become people usually of the important and living environment, it is people to construct the own and living tasty, and pursue the human life ego, and express culture cultivated manners of place, and these too made the indoors space become 1 1000 style for with a hundred growing the appearance, specialties, even eccentricity design style, but create this kind of environment atmosphere of an important means, is a light and color of design application, mental state for having the abundant lighting level of structure with color level of structure, can making the environment space the containment the chill and warmth, clear and murk variety, creating be borning moving the come-hither environment atmosphere, satisfying people, physiology request.

articleTitle: The research and application of artificial intelligence technology in exploiting the CAD system for windows and doors
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The research paper is directed to the cutting calculation problem concerning the CAD for windows and doors. By introducing an expert system technology to this problem, this research applies Inference mechanism to automatically generate the cutting calculation, thereby achieving intelligence computerization for windows and doors cutting. Meanwhile, this research proposes to introduce a neural expert system into the application module for selecting windows and door model pattern. Consequently, the selection of window and door patterns becomes more reasonable and the advantages of neural network expert system are fully played out. This paper provides a method by which the artificial intelligence technology is introduced to the exploitation of the CAD system for windows and doors, thereby significantly enhancing the intellectualization of efficiency of the CAD system.

Author Keywords: Selecting the Doors and Windows Pattern

articleTitle: Improved OBB fitting method for elongated objects
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: We present a new method of calculating OBBs of the internal nodes in OBB-tree for elongated objects which are partially ordered. By establishing a new estimating function, we convert the problem of determining OBB's orientation to constrained extrema problem which can be solved by Lagrange multiplier method. After solving the estimating function we get a local axis of the OBB. The remaining two directions are calculated using minimal-area bounding rectangle algorithm. Project all the vertices to the local axes respectively then the size and center of the OBB can be finally determined. A large amount of tests have revealed that the OBB-tree constructed by this method fits better than those constructed by the already existing methods. Now the method proposed by this paper has been adopted by actual project.

articleTitle: The impact of the unity of product image design on corporate brand image
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: From several basic structures for indoor computer wireless communication system, At present, facing the Internationalization's strategic needs, establish a clear corporate image and brand is essential for an enterprise's survival and development, and product image as an important means of reflect the corporate image are receiving more and more attention. Papers from the point of view of product design, through the integration of theory and case analysis, sort out the relationship between corporate brand image and the unity of product image design, as well as the use of means to enhance the brand image.

articleTitle: X3D experiences on a Hydro Junction digital: A case study of Three Gorges Dam
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This work presents our experience in using Virtual Reality techniques to digitally reconstruct the World famous Hydro Junction- Three Gorges Dam. This paper discusses the work undertaken by the China Water Museum to develop X3D-based Water Museum Virtual Reality System. This system is to deal with difficulties in applying 3D information system in virtual reality experience, which is written in Extensible-3D (X3D) and Java. In order to achieve an accurate 3D representation, the process was divided in phases to better structure and fundament such development: historical data gathering and analysis; 3D modeling and; interactive immersive visualization. Due to the nature of this project, different people from different areas of expertise were involved, working together in a unified development environment. It is our opinion that the online design review has achieved its objectives. However we identified some features that would improve collaboration such as digital 3D annotation and support for online collaboration in current X3D browsers.

articleTitle: The new type of national graphics symbol in modern product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The national graphics symbol and the product design each other all are the divine creative force cultures, manifesting in the entire national culture system as the productive forces commodity culture attribute, may be mutually the reference. The national graphics symbol is the most representational manifestation of being the traditional culture concept and the nature in the graphics symbol. It integrates tradition culture and the modern graph constitution, forms modern performance symbolic forms of national symbol significance and so on modern dissemination, artistic reappearance, cultural inheritance. The form style esthetic sense of the national graphics symbol lies in emphasising the form feeling of graphics symbol simplifies, stressing constitution relations of abstract physique structure and function union, thus well expressing and understanding nationality graphics symbol organization and structure.

articleTitle: Focus on lifestyle and seek the innovative point of furniture design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The connotation and extension of furniture design, which aims to enhance the quality of people's lives, is constantly expanding and improving. The innovation of furniture design also demands us to take the users' prospective, focus on people's lifestyle, seek the designing elements and seize the designing inspiration so as to complete the design.

articleTitle: A method of product style design with the amalgamation of folk culture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: It is analyzed that the necessities and significance of the amalgamation of folk culture into product design. A method of product design has been proposed based on amalgamation of folk culture. Focusing on choosing the theme of folk culture and finding the natural link to folk culture and product, the design flow was given as “Establishing cultural theme -identifying characteristics of folk cultural elements - Imitation or innovation design”, then a product embodying folk culture can be obtained. A chair was designed to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: A P2P based collaborative reverse engineering for rapid product development
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This research is to explore an route of collaborative reverse engineering system for 3D digitization, 3D streaming, rapid CAD modelling, re-design, analysis, and CNC manufacturing of mechanical product with complex freeform surface on a P2P-based distributed collaborative product development environment in inter- or across- enterprise. This paper focuses on developing an integrated framework of JXTA-based P2P collaborative network infrastructure, hierarchical product information model, B-spline surface model reconstruction, and tool path generation based on Open CASCADE kernel. A experimental prototype has been developed and validates the efficaciousness of proposed P2P based collaborative reverse engineering solution to integrate applications and manufacturing resources, and enable geographically dispersed development teams and customers to work together concurrently and to communicate interactively among themselves on a specified activity.

articleTitle: Research on design method of product semantics based on regional culture differences
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper analyzes the application methods and techniques of elements of regional culture acting as product semantic elements in the product design process, and uses design knowledge to build models as well as the concept of application to investigate and record regional cultures. Then combined with product semantics, this paper abstracts the analysis on available semantic elements in the regional cultures. Directed towards the abstracted cultural elements, this paper classifies its properties and establishes cultural semantic elements base. In the regional product design process, this paper derives the cultural semantic elements in corresponding areas, and redesigns the products based on the original reusable three-dimensional model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Inheriting and development of modern Xieyi school flower-bird painting
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Interaction system design in Virtual Science and Technology Museum
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtual Science and Technology Museum (VSTM) is a virtual 3D walkthrough system which combines virtual reality with computer networks.
