In this paper, from the perspective of interaction design, according to user-centered principle, we first carry out a system architecture analysis for Virtual Walkthrough System, set down the content of interaction design and design goals; then, with the example of VSTM, user analysis is completed using a interaction design method, followed by a research on interaction processes, interactive objects and interaction mode of VSTM, and finally, a complete program of interaction is given.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of a multi-channel simultaneous display technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article focused on the two multi-channel system splicing technology, which are flat-panel screen and ring-screen, and also given the realization method. Established a distributed communication environment by selecting TCP protocol, the multi-channel systems are optimized by adding the maximum relevant waiting time for the communication process between the Master-side and the Slave-side, achieved a large-screen multi-channel 3D display system, gives a passive multi-channel 3D display system hardware solutions. The experimental results show that the system has a good performance on the real-timing, consistency and the display.

articleTitle: A novel watermarking scheme for 2D vector CAD drawings based on blind source separation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper proposed a novel watermarking scheme for 2D vector CAD drawings based on blind source separation (BSS). Little research has been conducted in watermarking such drawings. In the scheme, watermark is embedded both into the line entities and circle/arc entities ,which increased the capacity of watermark. Shape distortions is avoided by keeping the topological structures of drawing unchanged. By means of FASTICA technique watermark can be extracted without the original drawings. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed watermarking scheme is almost completely robust to rotate, scale, transplant (RST) as well as their combinations, and also strong enough to cropping attacks.

articleTitle: Chronology of the basic car style in 20th
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this study was to review the chronology of passenger car style and as a result, the chronological table of typical model style by Ford was made. It could be extracted nine basic styles which would be the symbol of car style for each age.

articleTitle: Application of Expressionism in Clothing Brand Ads
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Starting from expressionism, this paper conducts a brief analysis on the cultural characteristics of expressionism and expounds the positioning principle and thinking characteristics of modern clothing brand ads. From the perspective of relationship between painting of expressionism and print advertisement, and with the methods of literature support, case study and image analysis, this paper analyzes, concludes and sums up the effect of expressionism painting's expression in concept, pattern, composition and color on the print ads for international clothing brands in recent years. This study can help designers of print ads and fashion photographer enhance the application of expressionistic techniques, thereby working out the print ads that are consistent with the cultural positioning and spiritual connotation of clothing brands.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a workflow-driven cooperative weave platform
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to the CSCW cooperative mechanism, this paper provides and builds a workflow-driven weave platform. Based on developmental computer network and information technology, the platform creates a collaborative work environment to carry out the share of manufacturing resources and the complementarities of technical resources. It actualizes the management of manufacturing workflow, shortens the manufacturing cycle of woven fabric and enhances the competitive capability of weave industry. This paper studies the architecture of cooperative weave manufacturing system, expounds the technique of pattern database. Finally, the realization of platform system and the conclusion are made.

articleTitle: Colour research and creativity in product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The concerning focus of industry design is how to improve product's creativity from colour design. This paper tells about the significance of colour research and its main contents. It discusses about the philosophy and design of product's colour creativity at the background of multiple subjects integration from three layers: highlighting the creativity of colour art design, creating the integration of colour engineering design, creating the system of colour research management.

articleTitle: Key points analysis on product structure design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, with a detailed structural design of the arm blood pressure monitor (ABPM), we presented the design process of plastic products, as well as some significant points, details and problems in structural design, when we also emphasized on the integral consideration of the products' appearance, functions, materials, structures and techniques in the design process.

articleTitle: The effective management of exhibition design corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the rapid development of economic on MICE (meeting, incentive, conference and exhibition), MICE industry has spawned many new industries, and the exhibition design industry is among them. However, the adverse development of the exhibition design industry hinders the development of MICE industry. Based on the analysis of the status quo of the exhibition design industry and the existing problems, this thesis aims to make a detailed study of effective management that ensure the rapid, steady and healthy development of the exhibition design industry. This whole thesis consists of seven aspects, including enterprise strategic management, brand building, the scale construction, etc.

articleTitle: An approach to 3D shape blending using point cloud slicing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Shape blending is of great theoretical and practical significance in industrial design, engineering simulation, etc. An approach to 3D shape blending using point cloud slicing is proposed in this article. It can be used in industrial design as an aid to design creativity. After the uniform slicing of each point cloud model, an improved ray-firing method is adopted to establish the correspondence between the vertices on two sets of cross-section contours. The vertex coordinates of the intermediate shapes are generated using the weighted mean methods, and the new contours are created. Finally, 3D model of the intermediate shape is obtained by constructing a loft surface. The example testifies that the algorithm has good stability and reliability. It provides a new way for innovation design of product shape.

articleTitle: A research and implementation of on-vehicle detection System of Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper provides and describes a method of on-vehicle detection system of Hybrid Electric Vehicle(HEV). Some functions like data detection, analysis, process and the control of Hybrid Electric model can be implemented based on LCD and touch screen interface. The designed system is not limited on normal processes of vehicle parameters such as speed, miles, rotation speed of engine, voltage and current, but includes the status of both vehicle and Hybrid Electric system's drive such as pile voltage, pile capability and residual miles. The testing subject of serial HEV is an alternated BJ212 jeep. The result of the experiment shows the designed system can accord with common driving habits, thus makes it a high practical value.

articleTitle: An inverse method for 3d aerodynamic design of wing shape
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Aerodynamic optimization design of wing shape is a complicated problem, so the computational efficiency of the method is very important. Genetic Algorithms (GAs) are strong tools for solving the large-scale optimization problems. They have very strong global search capability, but poor local search capability. This makes GAs converge very slowly especially when they are used for such complex question as the inverse design of 3d wing shape. The genetic operators are specially designed and Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA) is introduced into Stochastic Gradient Genetic Algorithm (SGGA). In fact, SPSA is a simple, easily implemented and efficient stochastic approximation algorithm. Also SGGA is used for the inverse design of wing shape. And flow field is calculated by means of wing supercritical analysis program-the software of simplification version of FLO22VSE. The paper explores a high efficient method for the inverse design of wing shape. The experiments show satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional simulation of the highway using the texture-mapping
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to get realistic appearance in building highway by using three-dimensional simulation technology, it is natural to do some complex calculations for the surface of the highway, involving patterns with certain colours and textures. Usually, the surface with single colour can be simulated by direct colouration. The surface involving complicated patterns with colours and textures need to use texture-mapping. In this paper, it is demonstrated that, not only the complexity of the calculation for the surface can be simplified, but also the improvement of the efficiency and quality for the three-dimensional simulation of the highway can be achieved, by choosing proper texture pattern and appropriate texture mapping. Thereby, a satisfactory highway constructed with 3D virtual reality technology appears.

Author Keywords: the change of the texture coordinates

articleTitle: Conceptual design of the travelling and combined units of life support based on mine disaster
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Mine disaster has been a worldwide problem for a long time. In recent years, frequently occurred mine disasters have brought serious negative impact on this society. So it is necessary to call for the respect and concern for humanity. In this article, we analyzed causes and the types of the mine disasters, explored a number of irrational and imperfect factors in the rescue process, and tired to carry out a preliminary plan for the travelling and combined units of life support, in order to extend the time of waiting for rescue and save more lives, and hoped it can offer tremendous benefits to guide the work of mine rescue in the future.

articleTitle: The algorithm of subdivide coons-surface with any appointed data point
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to realize the partial modification of coons-surface and its subtler optimization, we should subdivide the coons-surface with appointed data. So, an algorithm of subdividing a coons-surface was presented by authors. First we calculate the boundary conditions of sub division surfaces based on the algorithm for C2 Hermite interpolation and the designated data points. Then we reconstruct these sub division surfaces according to above calculating boundary conditions and blend them. The experimental results show that these sub surfaces created by this algorithm can be blended well, and the blended surface has same shape with original coons-surface.

articleTitle: Research and practice on computer aided ergonomie design system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Aimed at evaluation and revision of cab space design, and based on standard model of the human sitting posture (50th percentile adult male), the paper takes the upper limb movement in human sitting posture as research object, using VC++6.0 and an open graphics program interface technology to realize the design of computer-aided ergonomic system. It's realized the simulation of postures and arm movement control in three-dimensional space, the initial construction of computer-aided ergonomics design system, and the basic framework of cab space evaluation and revision.

articleTitle: The structural analysis of model construction based on element method
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Element method model construction, a new approach for product modeling, is to positively impact on the front-end modeling methods for product design through boundary-lines of design deriving from progressive constraints on different parameter conditions.

articleTitle: The research of reverse valuation methods used for product image assets
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper established valuation methods of enterprises product image assets according to earnings present value methods of intangible assets valuation methods on condition that enterprises product image assets is intangible assets, The assets valuation methods of reverse calculation of the enterprise product image overcome the shortcomings of traditional assessment ideas.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation method of the similarity of the products identity
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Products identity is the core of product innovation. To maintain similarity between series products is the principal method to establish brand identity. It is the main problem that evaluation targets can not be quantitative expressed, which constraints objectivity and authenticity of the evaluation results. An intensive study on evaluation methods of the similarity of the products identity has been made on the basis of plenty of related research at home and abroad. Fuzzy information was made quantitative expression by using the knowledge of fuzzy mathematics, discriminant table calculation and etc. Then synthesis of fuzzy matrixuse methods were applied to solve the problems of quantitative evaluation. Also, an example of automobile was used to proved the method in this paper.

articleTitle: The research and exploration of how to train professionals in industrial design teaching program
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays industrial design has become the motivation force of the development of the society, it transforms our ways of life, improves the quality of our lives and promotes market competition. In the tendency of globalization, it plays an important role in the enterprise innovation. The enterprise demands talents in the field of industrial design. Under this condition, it requires the colleges and universities training new industrial design talented persons who have real understandings of the relationships between the humanity, the product and the market and who have solid theoretical knowledge of science and technology, the capacity for scientific thinking as well as the ability of proficiency in a practical skill. At the same time, they must have comprehensive accomplishment in the area of the humanities, arts, society and so on. They are sensitive to the form and the structure of products In this article, through the investigation on the university characteristics, the teaching methods, and the educational model and so on, the expansion of industrial design teaching ideas is explored; exploration and some research on the ways of how to train professional talents in the industrial design major teaching are provided.

articleTitle: An improved architecture of item-based collaborative filtering system for Chinese texts
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese papers have become a major resource for Chinese researchers to learn about the status of their fields. Information filtering technique can help people to find useful information among these resources online. An efficient information filtering approach is needed to prioritize Chinese papers so that Chinese researchers can spend less time searching for papers of their interest. Since traditional collaborative filtering algorithm has the problems of sparse matrix and low accuracy, which will influence the results of prediction. This paper presents the architecture for Chinese texts filtering. An algorithm based on the similarity of information items is also proposed. It can solve the sparse matrix problem and improve the efficiency of prediction. Preliminary experiment shows the efficiency of this algorithm.

articleTitle: On the rhythm and metre of bronze wine vessels' form curves in Shang & Zhou dynasty
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Bronze wine vessels were not only important ritual vessels, but also containers with elegance form and graceful pattern, which have far-reaching influence to Chinese traditional form and aesthetics. The paper analyzes the characters of rhythm and metre in bronze wine vessels' form curves through withdrawing and refining the form curves, and is presented to offer direction and consulted data to modern design of wine vessels.

articleTitle: Thinking of the future attribute of Chinese characters under the condition of new media technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper attempts to draw attention to the reconsideration of design methods Chinese characters from a historical perspective by comparing several actual cases, and proposes that properties of Chinese character, under the condition of new media technology, should include its material, three-dimensional display, color and light, the way of movement, change of sound and compatibility with the environment besides form. This paper also explores the design method of Chinese characters-providing a more diverse experience to audience by design cases.

articleTitle: Process for obtaining conceptual designs to solve general problems
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper describes the creative process used by students in a free elective course offered at the Technical University of Catalonia (UPC) to obtain conceptual designs that contribute at least to the partial solution of a global crisis or major problem such as water shortage, food and energy crises, climate change and global mobility. An example of this process, which is based on exercises of imagination, mind maps and the six thinking hats method, is provided. This exercise is generalisable to other cases where a general problem is the starting point of a top-to-bottom process to find interesting solutions.

articleTitle: GPU accelerated preprocessing for potential-visible set
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A pre-processing technique for potential-visible set of the region of the great 3D scenes by using the highly processing power, parallelism and general-purpose computation of GPU is presented. The precision of scene segmentation and maximum error are used to adjust the computing speed and the accuracy of the potential visible set and the required storage space, which could deeply decrease the cost of the calculation of the general region's PVS. The result demonstrated our novel algorithm can provide a good complete solution for the calculation of the visible objects in the complex game scenes and reduce the geometric data is sent to the rendering pipeline largest possibly.

articleTitle: Based on form means of the exhibition design visual communication research
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: from the designer's angle, the final work of exhibition design is an artwork. One of the missing in the exhibition design art is to produce the sense of artistic in form. starting from the angle of form means, the article discusses the overall form and holds that “the meaningful form” is the soul of the visual sense in the exhibition design. The designers should exert the power of “form” and linked the relations between form and meaning, form and psychology, form and life, and display the infinite charm of form.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A decorative study on art symbols in miao embroidery in hunan and guizhou province of China
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A study on shape optimization of bus body structure based on stiffness sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The research of autobody lightweight technology is an important mainstream in the autobody design. In this paper A FEM model for the unitary body of a home-made bus is established .Then optimization design variables are determined through stiffness sensitivity analysis and by using finite element analysis software, an optimization is conducted, based on which a lightweighting scheme is put forward. The experiment indicated that after appropriate optimization the mass of the whole car body decrease 19.35Kg and the stiffness of the autobody maintained invariable.

articleTitle: Wire sections' optimization of rhombic wire wound vessel based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The ANSYS development tool - APDL can be used to build the finite element model of wire wound vessel considering the wires' interbedded friction. Only a handful of parameters have to be input in order to accomplish the whole process of program development such as constructing model, meshing, generating contact pairs, applying restrictions and loads as well as solving and post-processing. We can use the developed batch program to achieve the finite element analysis of the vessel's stress field for different wire's sectional dimensions and get the rule of the rhombic wire wound vessel's carrying capacity along with wire's sectional dimensions, which will provide a reference for design and optimization of wire's section.

articleTitle: Research on the methods of form semantic about the product design based on NURBS surface technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This issue combined the theory about history of auto style design, configurations and the semantic of product, through the investigation and study among the people, found out the most impressive distinguish among all kinds of cars; next, analyzing the different semantic relations among the different surfaces which are pieced together into the whole configuration of a car, simulating the surface with NURBS technology in the 3D-modleing software, and to obtain the data from these parameter surfaces. Finally, this issue build a ¿semantic-data corresponding system¿ contains the correspondence of data about surfaces and semantic about surface. To prove the system, the issue finished an auto style design with the data which were get from it, then made a investigation about the impressing when people gave the first sight to the work. The result of the study show us that this system was rational and it worked well in the process of style design because it can provide efficient directions to the designers.

articleTitle: A 3D shape blending based approach for product form design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A 3D shape blending based approach for product form design is addressed in this article. Different from traditional CAD tools, this method is not for design express but a tool can be used to stimulate designer's inspiration and assist in creative design of product shape. New shapes can be generated by blending two different product models into new ones automatically and by doing further treatment of the new models. For the realization of the method, a new 3D shape blending algorithm based on triangular decomposition is proposed, and the key work of the algorithm is described. Two examples are enumerated to verify the feasibility of the approach finally.

articleTitle: Research on distributed virtual environment based on web
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, a synthetic natural environment concerning topography, weather, hydrological geology and sound is introduced, and a kind of virtual reality where virtual environment is interrelated and linked together with real one is also described. System model of vehicle simulator is given and distributed virtual environment architecture is put forward. The paper also introduces object management module, event management module and protocol process module in the client, resource management module, scene management module, time management module, consistent management module in the server, which is significant to the construction of distributed virtual environment.

articleTitle: Analysis and emulation of steady-state characteristic for water hydraulic proportional throttle valve
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new type of water hydraulic proportional throttle valve is designed. The mathematical models of steady-state control characteristic, flow characteristic and load characteristic for the new designed water hydraulic proportional throttle valve are established, in addition some main factors influencing steady-state characteristic are determined, and some steady-state characteristic analysis such as displacement initial current, flow initial current, dead zone and hysteresis and other characteristic is also proceeded. The analysis and emulation show that spool displacement has a good linear relation with input current, and that the output flow of water proportional throttle valve is not only related to type of valve port, but also affected by working pressure difference. In order to gain better steady-state characteristic, the working pressure difference of valve port should be compensated or closed-loop control should be adopted. The result is of great instructive significance for optimizing design parameters of the water hydraulic proportional throttle valve, analyzing dynamic characteristic and designing control system.

articleTitle: Orderly information in graphic system and guiding recognition system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Visual elements in the graphic system are carriers of the guiding recognition system and are bonds between practical function and aesthetic function of the guiding recognition system, which can better deal with spatial relationships between the guiding recognition system and the environment. This article analyzes the relevance of the establishment of orderly information between graphic system and the guiding recognition system through the acting force, the coincidence intensity, and perception intensity of the graphic system in the guiding recognition system.

articleTitle: A novel vibration sieve based on the parallel mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new concept of vibration sieve based on parallel kinematic mechanism (PKM) is proposed in this paper and a novel 2-DOF spatial parallel mechanism is also designed here. The screen box fixed on the moving platform of the parallel mechanism poses an independent vertical translation and two rotations (one rotation is independent and the other is derivative). The trajectory of the screen-surface appears a serial of complex spatial curves, which is suitable for sieving materials effectively. A kinematics model for positive and inverse solution of the mechanism is also derived. According to the technical demands of the sieving, the dimensions of the links are designed, and the three-dimension solid model motion is simulated. Then, the track equation of points on the moving platform is deduced and the track curves are plotted using MATLAB. The prototype is manufactured at last. All these works provide a foundation for optimizing design of the technical parameters.

articleTitle: Automotive sketch processing for reverse transformation into 3-D
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduces a way to make automotive sketches ready for 2D to 3D reverse transformation. Three aspects of problems are discussed including the pre-processing of sketches outside computer, the processing of pre-processed sketches inside computer, and the extraction of features. Some of sketch processing algorithms are implemented using the MATLAB image processing toolbox. The work describe here is concerned with the production of a feasible routine, from the point of view of application, which is capable of dealing with the real world characteristics of automotive sketches. The combined algorithms, which are discussed in this chapter, have been found to be useful.

articleTitle: Based on COMCOSXPRESS analysis of mechanical properties of the plastic honeycomb board used in furniture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article deals with a kind of plastic honeycomb core composite board which has simple processing technology, light quality, pleasant appearance and can be waterproof, moisture-proof, pollution-free, scientific and environmental protection. The core content of this article is how to select the most appropriate cellular diameter through the design concept to ensure the compressive strength and material savings. Authors do stress analysis on the cellular by COMCOSXPRESS in order to design the plastic honeycomb composite board meeting the national furniture standard.

articleTitle: Analysis on the relation between enterprise brand image and product image
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Enterprise brand image and product image likes twins in market competition. The enterprise brand image acts as a guide for product image and the product image as a support for the enterprise brand image, that is, they coordinately develop and influence each other. The enterprise can survive in the fierce competition only by giving consideration to both of them, placing equal emphasis on both of them with neither aspects neglected.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the filling stage of Gas-Assisted Co-Injection Molding with incompressible Leonov fluid model
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Government equations of the filling stage of Gas-Assisted Co-Injection Molding in the thin cavity and gas channel were set up separately with the incompressible Leonov constitutive equation. Control-volume/finite-element method was used to solve the governing equation. The result was served as input for the residual stress calculation. Different methods were adopted to tracking the advancements of different moving fronts during filling stage. Then numerical simulation code for the filling stage was developed. A verification has been carried out and the results were reasonable. It shown that the mathematical models of Gas-Assisted Co-Injection Molding and the numerical methods were valid.

articleTitle: Applications of computational fluid dynamics in design of oil-mist collection
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new kind of oil-mist collection is design to reduce the harm of oil-mist produced by cold-former to people and environment. This paper stimulates the flow field of air amplifier by using Fluent and obtains the speed vector by adopting the standard turbulence model and supplying air from different speed. It is validated that air amplifier is a perfect part of the oil-mist collection.

articleTitle: Study on the area of the characteristic sections of figure for apparel Made to Measure
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The apparel made to measure (MTM) system has been investigated in developed countries at present. The base and key of the MTM is the 3D body measurement system (BMS). In this paper, we study the characteristic sections of figure by analyzing the output files of [TC]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> BMS. We choose the figure model of VRML format to extract sets of the intersection points of the figure model and given plains with the height defined as the characteristic level sections height from the output of [TC]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in ORD format, and calculate the areas of figure characteristic level sections and the ratio of the girth to area, establish foundations for figure classifications for apparel personal design and made to measure.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on imitative product design innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Main methods of product innovation were introduced, and the importance of imitative product design innovation for the enterprise's development was put forward. Meanwhile the article analysed the advantages of the imitative product development to the initiative product development and ways for imitative product innovation. It also introduced the situation of China about the imitative innovation development and problems that existed.

articleTitle: The parallel communication application in cranes stride over a same rack
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: It was Introduced that the ultrasonic sensor checking device union PLC communication function apply to anti-collision protect system of bridge cranes stride over the same rack in the railway service workshop. Authors designed hardware and software system of the parallel network communication based on FX2N series PLC, realized Information communication and long-range control between bridge cranes stride over the same rack in a workshop, ensured effectively the safe distance between the cranes, prevented from the collision accident, improved the work assurance coefficient and availability, provided the technology for realizing the Intellectualization, transparent factory and entire integrated automatic system.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Application of Bamboo in Modern Product Design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: By means of field research, this study conducts a staged investigation on the market conditions and traditional & modern technologies for bamboo processing, collects and sorts the data regarding design of modern bamboo products, analyzes the relationship between individual differences in material and utilization rate, and draws the conclusion that the more individual differences are, the lower the utilization rate is. Also, it's believed in this study that the bamboo materials with great individual differences must be used together with other materials so as to achieve reasonable configuration, thereby overcoming the problems in structure, function and aesthetic appreciation. Moreover, this paper conducts an analysis from the perspectives of point, line, surface and volume, sums up the application of various types of bamboo materials, and finally demonstrates the design of modern bamboo products by designing a set of bamboo-board table and chairs for dining.

articleTitle: The research on the development of the form on the urban public space in china in the period of 1949–2008
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The urban square form is discussed in this paper. The time from 1949 to 2008 is an important stage for the development of urban square form in China. The study results show that the design of the square form ranges from the simple geometric configuration to the natural configuration based on the geometric form, which is caused by the development of the politics economy as well as the change of the square function during the 60 years (1949–2008).

articleTitle: Research on users' product material perception
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Material plays an important role in product design and affects consumers' preference in purchase. To study the user's material perception, a novel approach of the semantic differential (SD) method was adopted. Taken the cup with different material as an example, the characteristics of users' material perception were concluded, such as transparent, reflexivity, texture, and then the weightiness of material perception was discussed. The study of the users' material perception of product will assist the designers in material design of product, and find out the material attributes and meaning for material design of product.

articleTitle: Application X3D to collaborative interior design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A collaborative interior design system is designed based on virtual reality. The techniques of X3D is adopted in this system, and the virtual scenes and human-computer interaction have been realized.

articleTitle: Research and application for virtual exhibition room of product design based on multimedia network technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The efficiency, cost, and truthfulness are essentially about the exhibition of product design (PD) as well as in a rapidly changing and keenly competitive environment. The work presented in this paper focuses on presenting a new kind of product exhibiting method of PD, which introduced virtual reality (VR) into the course of exhibition of PD. In this paper, we bring up the structure model of the virtual exhibition room of product design (VRER) based on multimedia technology, and aim at expounding the method and process by which we construct the system. With the constant development of the multimedia technology, especially the network technology, we have more and more abundant exhibition means of PD. The virtual exhibition room of PD regarded as a new multimedia technology is one of the results. The VRER integrating with the sense of sight, hearing, and the tactile sense, can offer impression and experience equated with the true environment. Furthermore, the characteristics of VRER, such as small file amount, easy transmitting, lifelike, interaction, and so on, make the product design exhibition swifter and more effective. The VRER not only increases the efficiency of the PD exhibition, but also cuts down the cost of the exhibition. Finally, a design of VRER for special type truck is employed to demonstrate the above viewpoints.

articleTitle: The research of computer aided garment designing system based on coreldraw
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper analyzes the feature of garment designing, makes a frame of computer aided garment designing (CAGD) system with parameterization design and twodimensional design which is based on coreldarw. The system contains two main function modules. One of them is computer aided garment parameterization design. The other is garment intelligent color real-time configuration. All this will improve the coporation's designing speed and level.

articleTitle: On Chinese contemporary Han Dress Movement
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Through analyzing phenomenon of Chinese contemporary Han dress movement, this paper obtains the reasons for the increasing popularity of Han dress and the growing Han dress movement. And based on discussing the five aspects of the potential problems existed in the process which the Han dress was transformed into full dress, it possesses a theatrical guiding significance for the Han dress movement to be healthy development, make the movement become an important part of the Chinese traditional culture renaissance.

articleTitle: Study on digital construction of Gannan Hakka cultural resources database
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As the study on Hakka culture has been carried out deeply and extensively, the Hakka culture has become a much influential science both domestic and all over the world. How to protect and manage the heritage of such Hakka culture is a extremely urgent task. This report puts forward some suggestions on the digital construction of Gannan Hakka cultural resources database in modern information age. In the meantime, it advises on how to use the virtual space of reality to present the true Hakka historical and geographic information with the linkage to references and images from museums, libraries and archives.

articleTitle: Study on the draw-forming process of the complex shaping part
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to solve a series questions at present existing in machining technology of the disc with complex shape such as long process flow, great affects among working procedures and high cost, according to the outline of the part, the drawing process has been finished by one process instead of two, which is on the basic of the finite element numerical simulation and the experiment on simple dies. The faults, such as incorrectness in the direct cliff, wrinkling in the gap, and the arc impress maintained after the first stretch on the part, are resolved effectively, and the quality and the efficiency are improved greatly.

articleTitle: Rapid modeling of Chinese traditional architecture driven by mapping data
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Profound mapping data were accumulated during over hundred years' mapping work of Chinese Traditional architecture. The data's digital processing techniques are still in the primary stage, so most of the data are kept on material media till now. The paper studied the rapid modeling techniques of Chinese traditional architecture driven by mapping data, based on parametric modeling techniques. Through the comprehension and processing of Chinese architecture's historic records, some digital design methods are realized. The data needed and missing for modeling are deducted intelligently, driven by witch the modeling work is completed rapidly.

articleTitle: Ideas on the teaching of product design basic courses
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the undergraduate period, the teaching of product design bases on the training of three-dimensional shaping with the aim of studying the relationships between shape, material, structure and function by which the students' ability of shaping could be developed. To be more scientific and efficient, in the teaching of basic design courses, the teacher should deconstruct the questions, put an emphasis on observing and analyzing, pay attention to the join up of courses, as well as the transition to product design.

articleTitle: Research on aesthetic evolution caused by digital art
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper discussed such possibility that viewed sense to aesthetic feeling experiences of virtual space as subjects in aesthetics, through describing some aesthetic phenomena and experiences in the present virtual field, then to put forward to some imagines on developing the visual field of nowaday aesthetics. And it expected to make a research by comparing between traditional time-space and digital art virtual opinions of space-time and aesthetic theory.

articleTitle: The mutual translation and expression of graphics-text
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the rapid development of modern society, the importance of graphics is constantly affirmed. Graphics is increasingly involved in human social life and ideology and has become a kind of cultural phenomenon and media that exchanges and communicates information and expresses feelings and awareness. As a pioneer of contemporary graphic design, during a thousands of years the folk patterns gradually has been developed into a unique free conversion system for the mutual translation of graphics-text, which provides a useful reference to the translation obstacles between oral language (speaking) and written language (painting) in the process of the graphic design. Based on the specific analysis of the text-graphics processing relationship in Chinese traditional folk patterns, this paper attempts to form the methods and inspiration that is practical and directive to graphic design.

articleTitle: Research of non-linear subdivision of triangular mesh model based on VRML
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to solve the problem of real-time collaborative mutual, a method which utilizing CAD software's interface to realize product model visualization is proposed in paper. The problem of triangular surface with G1 continuous construction, non-linear interpolation and subdivision of triangular mesh, data structure which the algorithm needed and data access method are mainly researched in paper. According to research motioned above, triangular mesh model visualization software based on VRML is developed.

articleTitle: Adaptive 3D navigation user interface design based on rough sets
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: An adaptive user interface has been developed to enhance the three-dimensional navigation adaptation in this paper. Rough sets are applied to user modeling including uncertainties, namely, vagueness and incomplete information about users during their navigations in the virtual environments. We propose an approach to generate the user types' decision-making table and identity the types by their interaction behaviors through the core reduction algorithm. Then, to structure the user adaptation templates, system can change the HCI to adapt to users' navigation knowledge, path-finding ways and other interaction attributes. A prototype system is described at the end, and it can improve the user performances in three-dimensional navigation.

articleTitle: Analysis method study of static strength on complex mechanical structures
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new design method which includes sub-model technology, 3D contact analysis of finite element, and Non-free boundary meshing method is put forward to perform the static strength analysis of complex mechanical structures. A crankshaft of a high power diesel engine is introduced as a design example and its strength safety factors are checked. Analysis results are in line with the actual operation of crankshaft, which states that the new design method developed in this paper is correct and effective. This design method lays the foundation for the further research on the dynamic simulation of complex mechanical structures.

articleTitle: The choice of package design in economical society
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, people call for the economical society. The market has the new requests with the related package design. Economics' form and narrowed production call for new package design. The economical packages achieve the lowest cost, and minimize resources consumption and maximize the benefits, while it expresses the complete design goal. It is the design of awareness from the individualism to the nature. How to design the package for economical society is focused in the paper.

articleTitle: A study on creative-thinking training that takes morphology as the core
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduces creative-thinking training into basic courses and the professional courses of industrial design classes, to solve the problem of teaching disconnection in basic courses and professional courses of industrial design, and to make creative thinking in design understood. This study will simplify the process of creativity, promote teaching to a higher stage by an easier-understanding way, e.g., to develop students' interests in design, help them to know creative design methods, thus to guide students to use logical thinking, image thinking and creative thinking in their design works. The aim of this study is to cultivate students' capacity of creation and expression.

articleTitle: Research and application of product identity introduction in sewing machine industry
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Under the circumstances of encouraging independent intellectual property, nearly all the enterprises were working hard to create new design for their products by means of industrial design, unfortunately, most of them only considered a product's market and appearance and made the business product identity very confusing. The solution was to introduce product identity (PI). This research put forward introducing product identity design in the enterprises, analyzed sewing machine enterprise's features, accomplished designing a type of sewing machine product identity system in Xi'an Typical Industry Co., Ltd. This case illustrated that the introduction of product identity design was both correct and feasible.

articleTitle: Knowledge-based small-calibre shells processing design technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: To the actual circumstances of the plants studied adapted to the processing plant design technology, including the ability to provide a knowledge-based database, which includes all of the processes, all of which use the resources, such as tools, measuring tool, fixture, but also the management of all the typical processing, process design and use of interactive design derived from a combination of design.

articleTitle: The research and development of parts library system oriented to high voltage switchgear
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: High voltage switchgear products always produce a great lot of parts models and design information in digital design. And such products have the characteristics of series and complexity. Therefor, this paper takes a certain series of outdoor HV isolating switchgear as an example, and multi-attribute mapping parts library system has been researched and developed based on C/S mode for corporate design department, which achieves an effective classification, dynamic management, information integration, reuse and variant design of parts. Simultaneity, this system is seamlessly integrated with the Inventor 2008 design software. All of these can greatly improve system efficiency and design efficiency, and shorten the product development cycle.

articleTitle: Calculating the minimum distance between two NURBS curves
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A novel method is proposed to compute the minimum distance between two 2D or 3D NURBS curves using control polygons in an efficient and robust way. The first step is to decompose both of NURBS curves into their piecewise Bzier forms. The second step is to use a two level selection process to select a subset of all possible pairs. The first level selection uses upper-lower bounding boxes of Bzier subcurves to remove pairs. The second level selection is based on the spatial relationship test between a pair of Bzier subcurves. The third step is to use a multidimensional Newton-Raphson method to compute the approximate local minimum distances of pairs of Bzier subcurves. By comparing all local minimum distances between a pair of Bzier subcurves, it is able to find the global minimum distance. The final step is to use the multidimensional Newton-Raphson method to improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: Experimental study in dynamic fonts
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: We live in an era of media and information explosion. Information is transmitted in various, constantly revolutionized forms. Movies, television and other new animated media have penetrated into all aspects of our life and become part of it. From those media we acquire knowledge, ways of communication and pleasure. The deep-seated difference between the new media and the traditional static media is that the new media presents information through animated visual images. Video images and text are the two components of the visual elements of animated media, where writing signs, the most important carriers of human culture, no more appear statically, but instead, they are presented dynamically. Today digital technology via computer programs are often employed to conceive, design and produce animated texts. New digital technology can realize any effect of animated texts that the brain of human can conceive. How to envision and how to create animated texts are problems on which media designers often ponder. By analyzing presentation manners and characteristics of visual images in movies, television and multimedia works, this paper boils down the principles and experiences in creation of dynamic texts into eight points of penetration, in an approach to the essential principles governing creative design of animated texts.

articleTitle: Furniture industry oriented computer-aided dragon and phoenix Decoration graphic system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The style of the furniture represents the culture of a country or a nationality, and it also reflects a nationality's art. Chinese dragon and phoenix are the symbol of Chinese nation. In this paper, a dragon and phoenix Decoration pattern system based on genetic algorithm is developed. The system not only saves designer's massive precious time, but also helps the designer to observe the detail of the design more carefully and observe the practical application straightly.

articleTitle: Research of product identity design based on form style and features
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper analyzed the principle of PI (Product Identity)—form style and identification of features. Relatively scientific method and proceeding of product identity design were constructed based on the knowledge of form style and features and integrated with statistics technology. Finally, the proposed method was tested by a practical product design case.

articleTitle: How design service organizations sustain competitiveness in production networks: Case study on industrial design firms
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The objective of this paper is to explore how design service organizations sustain competitiveness in production networks. In trends of global sourcing and production networks, manufacturing enterprises outsource more and more activities and become dependent much on their network suppliers. Design service firms play multiple roles in the network, knowledge and network relationship are essential for them to take advantages. The study focus on industrial design firms, a research framework is developed through literature, and a multiple case study was conducted to illustrate and explore the details. It is presented that successful design firms are rich in knowledge in all levels of user, organization and networks, and knowledge in user domain are emphasized. The abilities of integration and collaboration are the key points to maintain and develop design relationship in production networks.

articleTitle: The application of ergonomic manual operation principle to the design of mouse
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper centers on the application of Man-machine Engineering knowledge and expounds the design characters of manual operation principle. By analyzing the physiology of hand and the mouse disease, we reach the conclusion about the design principle for using man-machine engineering in manual operation device. So, according to the process of product design, we apply it to the mouse simulated design reasonably.

articleTitle: Application of OPC technology in monitoring system of AS/RS
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper discusses the OPC technology and it brings functions and benefits in monitoring system of the small AS/RS. As an example of the monitoring system of an airport catering company, the paper analyzes the way of data access in this monitoring system according to the typical data access method of OPC. The monitoring system adopts Siemens S7-300 PLC Ethernet communication module and OPC communication mode which the two are combined. The system brings the nether system into the Ethernet communication system which realizes the stability communication and data transmission between PC and PLC, thus to realizes real-time monitoring of monitored objects.

articleTitle: On the use of product innovation in the design process of the research
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This study is based on ¿user at the core¿ of human nature to study the chemical product design of the spindle, the OHP by the general market for the subject matter of the projector, to explore the field of industrial design in consumer electronics products, ¿the use of¿ problem. The study found that by the terms of the duration of the project to test the operational problems as the definition of degree of difficulty, can be summarized into easy, medium, three levels of difficulty. Which started in the projector part of the two 2,3, and in the incorporated part of the D, E 2 are the use of bad design. In addition the graphical instructions in haste, but also allows users to easily confused, they are advised in future studies to improve the situation.

articleTitle: Individualized product requirement information modelling and analysis based on customer driven
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to accomplish the product special requirements of customers and establish the product developing platform for non-professional effectively, the requirement feature and requirement agile expression model of individualized product were put forward. The logical meta model and physical structure model of individualized product requirement information were built, the basic management and operating of model integration, mapping, extraction, refine and recombination were accomplished in terms of XOEM based. The Man-machine coordination requirement information analysis was built to simplify spatial search of system. The synchronization validation of requirement compatibility was accomplished by Bottom-Up reduction to ensure the reliability and validity of product information which customer express.

articleTitle: Design of technology-based self-service for ICU patients' families
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Caring in intensive care unit (ICU) is taken seriously in the whole medical process. Past research usually focused on satisfying ICU patients or medical personnel's needs, requirements of patients' families were often been ignored. To establish “CarePlus” - a comprehensive technology-based self-service (TBSS) for ICU patients' families - is the objective of this research. Based on the finding through literature review and investigation on needs of patients' families, design of services were developed, which include Hospital Related Information, ICU Related Information, ICU Patient's Family Related Information, Living Information, Patient Nursing Information, Medical Information, Consultation Hotlines, Religious and Spiritual Support. ICU of NCKU Hospital was employed for evaluation, where target subject tested the dedicated TBSS and their feedbacks were analyzed quantitatively. The result indicates that patients' families show high affirmation toward CarePlus, and their need gaps will be reduced after trying this service.

articleTitle: Sensory evaluation of men's suitings based on a fuzzy-genetic model
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The tactile assessments on a set of men's suitings were conducted by an expert panel according to the standardized techniques and processes. Based on the obtained sensory data, a hybrid model integrating the use of fuzzy set theory and genetic algorithms was then developed to study the fuzzy relations between various sensory components and the total fabric hand. In this method, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) was introduced to model the sensory evaluation, and the genetic algorithm was applied to seek a near-optimal weight distribution amongst the seven evaluation criteria. Finally, by comparison with the heuristic methods and the experimental results, the fuzzy-genetic model proposed in this study was verified to be effective and reliable.

articleTitle: The feasibility of implementing web-based instruction in Basic Design course : A case study of the i-learning system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: By implementing asynchronous web-based instruction platform on assisted teaching and using the same design project topics, this study compares the learning achievements of the traditional teaching method and the web-based instruction method. At the moment, whether the teaching content and characteristics of Basic Design courses, the methods and steps of teaching activities, and the methods and process of grading assignments are able to be applied on practical instruction platforms or not are being profoundly discussed. Moreover, by using questionnaire surveys, whether the learning achievements of applying web-based instruction to Basic Design courses is superior to traditional teaching and if it can be replaced or not is also discussed in this study. Research has shown that the main efficiency of implementing web-based instruction in Basic Design courses is: providing course information and learning content, discussing and sharing what one has learned, encouraging students to ask questions and tracing learning progresses. However, since the learning process lack immediate responses, the quality and feel of the network is unable to be displayed properly, and the display of creations and compositions is limited. Therefore, web-based instruction is still unable to replace the traditional way of giving lessons; it can only play the role of an assistance tool for advancing and promoting learning achievements of students.

articleTitle: Simulating forest landscape change under Larch caterpillar and fire disturbance in Great Xing'an Mountains, Northeastern China
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: We used the LANDIS model to evaluate the effects of fire and Larch caterpillar disturbance on species abundance, age structure, spatial pattern, and age structure of two main species(LAGM(Larix gmlinii) and BEPL(Betula platyphylla)) in Huzhong forest bereau on the north slops of Great Xing'an Mountains, Northeastern China. We compared the change of forest in ND(no disturbance) and BF(budworm and fire) scenarios. The results showed that fire and Larch caterpillar disturbance increased the abundance of BEPL, and increased seedling and middle-aged class of BEPL, however, decreased the aggregation index of BEPL cohorts significantly. Both Larch caterpillar and fire disturbance only increased the abundance of LAGM in later simulations lightly, and have no significantly effects on the aggregation index of LAGM, in the BF scenario, the proportion of seedling cohorts and Middle-aged cohorts under BF scenario higher than ND scenario in the middle of simulation years. Therfore, it is necessary to consider the influences of Larch caterpillar and fire diaturbance on forest in the future.

articleTitle: On the design method of modern Chinese furniture based on typology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Modern Chinese Furniture is gradually focused with the furniture industry, and it becomes an important research subject to create and design. By the application of typology method, the paper tries to use a rational concept and method to explore and analyze new Chinese furniture design and innovation, thus providing for the design of practical help.

articleTitle: Brand communication and product innovation research
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The influence of the brand communication and the innovation of product design by questionnaire investigation on consumers' purchase willingness is studied using the factor analysis, correlation analysis, regression analysis and statistical theory with SPSS 16.0. The results show that the brand communication plays a significant role on effecting consumer's purchase willingness towards products with ordinary designed appearances, on the other hand, the effect towards products with innovatively designed appearance is not that obvious, it depends on the consumers' fondness for the innovative products.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent assistant system of product form realization orient process
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the process of product design, structure, materials and process is interaction. Only knowing them as a system can design a good product. The designer make litter of structure, materials, process lead to a conflict between rational structure and emotional appearance, and the difference of concept design and the production program. The difference is sometimes a lot, and even unpredictable. Under the theory of the concurrent engineering and the deficiencies of designer, an intelligent assistant system of product form realization is established. The use proved it can reduce the difference, and conducive to the unification of structure rational and appearance Emotional.

articleTitle: Digital manufacturing technology for spring coiling
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In the numerically controlled manufacturing process of the spring, there are some problems such as lower automation and inconvenient operation. In view of this situation, the paper presents the approach of digital manufacturing for spring. The composition and the key technology of the digital manufacturing system are revealed, and an example is given to illustrate the system application. The digital manufacturing system provides the new method for spring coiling as well as forms the basis for integrating of spring's design and manufacture.

articleTitle: Re-definition and analysis to the three elements of design constitute - point line and plane
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Point, line and plane are the three elements constitute the design, visual design in the areas of the important position which is obvious. However, many professional scholars for many years failed to understand the good and the true meaning of its application to real social environment, often such a situation is this: In order to constitute the composition, learned later was completely lost. These phenomena we can from the many products designed to verify fully. What is the cause of it? Through systematic and detailed study, we can easily find the crux of the problem lies in the fact that a number of important professional books or professional media in regard to points, lines and surface definition. Therefore, we must in a timely manner for point, line, surface re-definition of the concept in order to achieve an objective, easy-to-understand, comprehensive results.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis magnetic airtight installation for rotary forced-air cooler
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The magnetic field distribution of new magnetic airtight installation for a rotary forced-air cooler is analyzed by finite element analysis software produced by ANSYS company., and the magnetic flux density of sealing gap is analyzed and discussed respectively in X and Y directions. The results show that in the magnetic airtight installatio with large gap, there is little effect on the magnetic field strength if changing sealing distance, but changing the amount of magnet can make magnetic field strength greatly improved and obtain ideal airtight effect. The practice shows that the magnetic airtight method and structure can be very effective to solove the leakage problems of a rotary forced-air cooler. So the exhausted gas can be recycled and the efficiency of resource utilization can be improved, therefore, cost is reduced, and good economic benefits can be obtained.

articleTitle: Integration of vehicle-track analysis tools for city rail systems
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, the vehicle-track system of city track traffic is being studied as a whole. The links between tools used by different engineering disciplines in the city track traffic field is investigated. A database of tool shares been set up and is being used to establish links between tools and, more importantly, gaps where tools are not interfacing as they could. The structure of the database is outlined in this paper. By the integrated analysis tool, the interaction between design, maintenance and operation of the vehicle and the effect on the track can be investigated. A sample system model is being set up which links some of the identified tools to demonstrate the interfaces in this paper. This system tool is then used to establish the effects of changes in one part of the system (such as the wheel-rail interface) on other parts of the system (such as interaction with the infrastructure).

articleTitle: Usage-style centered research for creative product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present systemic creative product design methods based on usage-style. According to the basic meanings of usage-style, the logical hierarchical structure of usage-style was outlined and established. Combining with product design principle, this work focused on the product values system and product structure system, established the design frameworks of `value forming from usage-style' and `structure forming from values by symbols', presented product creative design ideas and methods, and resented some practical case studies. The results indicated that usage-style includes three levels of operational activity, such as usability, friendliness and desirability. And by analysing different levels of usage-style, designer can achieve physiological and cognitive ability of user, comfortable and conventional usage values, psychological and emotional values, cultural and aesthetic values, and can achieve some design ideals, such as functional design, barrier-free design, universal design, personal and emotional design, and cultural and aesthetic design. These design ideals can make design origin change from product or market to usage-style and make products meet the reasonable multiplex usage-styles of users' expectation.

articleTitle: Deformation analysis of the thin wall member under shock load
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this text, the method of deformation calculation for the thin wall member under shock load. We made research into impact, distortion of the thin wall member which is under constraint condition of freely supported beam by dint of emulation though MATLAB and the finite element analysis software ANSYS, the object of this research is aluminium alloy thin wall member.

articleTitle: Research on the industrial design engineering of packaging machines
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Although the quality of electromechanical products of China such as packaging machines reaches a high level, it still lags in the field of industrial design. This paper demonstrates how to carry out the industrial design of this kind of products with the case of automatic feeder thermal transfer printer and floor-type labeling machine which we briefly introduce for the limitation of paper. On the basis of such practice, in the end of paper we conclude the method of industrial design in such electromechanical products.

articleTitle: The reconstruction of the finite element model of artificial knee joint based on RE technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new method about reconstructing the finite element model of artificial knee joint is presented in this article after the research on reverse engineering (RE for short). Firstly, on the basis of the prosthesis prototype, IMAGEWARE and PRO/E are used to deal with point cloud of prototype and then prosthesis model is reconstructed; secondly, based on CT of human knee joint, distal femur (DF for short) and proximal tibia (PT for short) are built after processing image and regulating gray value; and finally all of the models built above are assembled in one order and exported finite element models, which forms the foundation of biomechanics analysis.

articleTitle: New decoration style in product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Currently, new decoration style is increasingly popular in product design. In this paper, the historical changes of modern decorative design are reviewed briefly, and the reasons for the “rise-fall-rerise” trend of decorative design are analyzed. Specifically, this study focuses on the application of new decoration style in product design and, by the case studies on the expressions combining minimalist form with rich decoration details, the expressional themes with strong romantic fantasy and classical feelings as well as the application of new materials & techniques, sums up the integrated features of new decoration style in modern product design.

articleTitle: 2-D to 3-D transformation of style design in CAD garment design software
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this article, we utilized standard 3-D table data points, acquired shape-defining points by appropriately increasing garment interval values, and conducted curved surface fitting to create 3-D garment effects. Key technical issues of virtual garment style design & display base on textile physical properties are introduced. According to current technical condition, an easier transformation mode has been developed throughout analysis works on key issues and difficulties encountered in recent years. We put forward the following idea: 3-D table should be established first.
