After that, structural points and structural lines on 3-D table are plotted, base on which the interval values are determined which leads to the creation of a virtual garment shape. We also concluded some effective and practical methods for 3-D garment style generation.

articleTitle: On the characteristics of technological aesthetics in modern furniture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the analysis of the technical factors, the technical performances and technical beauty involved in modern furniture, the paper discusses the prescription of technological aesthetics in modern furniture design, and further extracts the factors related to technological aesthetic which will be applied in the process of modern furniture design.

articleTitle: The architecture of human motion information acquisition system based on surface EMG
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The architecture of human motion information acquisition system based on surface electromyography (EMG) was described. Motion information is one of the most important techniques in the intelligent assistant production design, and it is a basis for the assistant system to supply appropriate and necessary actions. Thinking of the characteristics of daily tasks, this system adopted surface EMG as signal source. Then, the motion recognition method based on multi-class support vector machine and the muscle force (joint torque) calculation algorithm based on muscle physiological model and geometric model are proposed. The experiments results proved the effectiveness of this system.

articleTitle: Research on CAD/CAM/CNC system for thin-walled part made of light metal based on spherical coordinate
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new kind of CAD/CAM/CNC system for the large thin-walled part turning, expressed in spherical coordinate, is present to improve the efficiency and quality of part machining, based on the analysis on the original processing technic. Moreover, the system mechanism and the design thinking of hardware and software are also introduced. In this system, a B-spline model for thickness surface is set up based on spherical coordinates, the space spiral path generation method is planned, row spacing angle and interpolation algorithm are determined, and the method for velocity control and acceleration control is present.

articleTitle: The simulation system of metro platform based on intelligent behavior-oriented passengers
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to improve the ability of driver that stops at the platform accurately and deals with the emergencies rapidly, the virtual environment of platform and vehicle should be created. The driver can observe the situation of platform and the intuitionistic process that passengers get on or off the train through it. In the paper, it was introduced the simulation system of metro platform based on intelligent behavior-oriented passengers in detail. The virtual environment of platform and vehicle were created based on scene graph and DOF technology. Combined with artificial intelligence, the movement model of passenger based on intelligent behavior-oriented was simulated. And the rendering method of mesh animation was used to realize the 3D visualization of passenger actions. The system not only can be used for metro driver training, can also be used to the evacuating simulation, CAD design and counter-terrorism exercise plan of station.

articleTitle: Research and application for design affairs management of product agile design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The efficiency and quality of product agile design (PAD) is essentially about designer as well as in a rapidly changing and strongly competitive environment. The primary objective of this fundamental research will be to propose the conception of product agile design management (PADM), which designed specially for design affairs management of product agile design. The author carried on deep research on PADM, and found out an effective management model. Furthermore, the author developed PADM system. The PADM system not only could be used in managing a design group, but also could accomplish the management work in connection with lots of groups in different places. The proposition of PADM perfected the theoretical system of design management (DM), and made the DM more flexible and practical. It had a positive function in promoting the development of DM theory in our country. Additionally, because that product agile design involves more than 80% product design cases in small and medium enterprises, and more than 60% product design cases in design companies, and more than 95% product design cases in universities and design colleges, the research on PADM can promote the effective merger of design resources, enhance the quality of design, and improve design efficiency. Finally, the PADM system was developed to realize the application in the process of quick product design.

articleTitle: The analysis of the enterprise logo redesign under the financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The logo, like the face of an enterprise, is a static symbol of the enterprise idea. In present society, an excellent logo design means a good stroke of business and becomes the powerful weapon for an enterprise to resist crisis and strengthen itself. The thesis observes and studies the change of Pepsi's logo under financial crisis, begins with the strategic reform and the brand promotion with the logo redesign, and analyzes how an enterprise manages its brands and seizes opportunities under financial crisis.

articleTitle: Decision-level fusion for collaborative service-oriented manufacture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Decision-level fusion is a high-level knowledge fusion service, which simulates the logic reasoning and cognitive thinking of human brain. The model of decision-level fusion for collaborative service-oriented manufacture is proposed based on the fusion process and service requirements. The model involves the approach of the quantitative description and dynamic fusion of the decision-level fusion, the modeling algorithm of the service resources and the modeling process based on multi-agent, the flexible and dynamic decision-level fusion mechanism. The implementation mechanism taking vehicular collaborative service for example is presented to validate the model of decision-level fusion for collaborative service-oriented manufacture.

articleTitle: The air-deflector and the drag: A case study of low drag cab styling for a heavy truck
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper has investigated the cab styling of heavy-duty truck with a low air drag based on aerodynamics and aesthetics. It focuses on the relationship of air-deflector, trailer and drag through an example of air-deflector styling. The parameters, the angle of air-deflector and the height of trailer, are specifically discussed here. The gap between cab and trailer is fixed. A lower drag cab is presented here by applying the CFD analysis result.

articleTitle: Life originated design automation theory and technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents Life Originated Design (LORD) automation theory to support conceptual design. Product information model based on functional surface (FS) and product data model is established. The functional pattern coding scheme is proposed to support automatic mapping from function to structure, solving the problems that are illstructure, multi-solution and uncertainty. A design automation process model is implemented. Finally, a prototype system LORD-DARFAD is developed and a product design case study demonstrates the operability and efficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: The regressive feminine design—To analyze the feminist consciousness in modern design elements
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As to the influence of societal concept, the females always live in the subordinate status in a great measure of historical development. To design profession, the deficiency of female consciousness leads to the imbalance of design. The rare feminist consciousness in design history such as the Rococo Style and the New Art Movement reflect the necessity and importance of feminine consciousness. The development of modern society makes the females go out to society gradually. Thus women consumption has gradually hold most of the consumer market. This paper analyzes the manifestation of female consciousness in modern design elements, and the significance and realization of feminine design from the perspective of women consumption market.

articleTitle: A study of positive effects on user experience in navigation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Since recent studies are concentrating on negative experience such as ¿lostness¿ and ¿disorientation¿, we emphasized the importance of positive experience in the paper. To investigate which behaviour is related to the user satisfaction, this paper examines the relationship between operational measures of user behaviour and users' positive experience. Several measures were used to evaluate the user behaviour, such as total task time, revisits and respond time. After the correlation analysis, we find that users' positive experience is correlated with optimal path rate, total task time and other four measures. In next steps, these measures will be developed to evaluate the website quality.

articleTitle: Interpretation of conceptual picture languages in packaging
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper studies the features, forms, and designs of conceptual pictures in commodity packaging, and interprets the language means of conceptual pictures in commodity packaging, in order to improve the manifesting force of the conceptual pictures by means of passing the information on commodities to the consumers swiftly, accurately, interestingly, and vividly, arouse the consumers' attention, enhance the competitiveness of the goods shelves, and thereby promote sales.

articleTitle: The CNC system based on SmarTeam mechanism and re-development of Pro/E
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Arming at the characteristic of shrapnel multi-type and variable batch, developing tools Visual C++ 6.0 and Pro/Toolkit are used, the CNC system based on SmarTeam Data Model is put forward. Effective management and utilization are carried out which are in the fields of the processing parameter inquiring, experience inquiring and G code of numerical control cutting, milling, drilling, boring and so on by SmarTeam, and then the process and results of the system is demonstrated by taking some shrapnel body cutting for example.

articleTitle: The modeling and knowledge acquiring for the forecast system of water atomized alloy powder's quality
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The forecast system of water atomized alloy powder's quality is an incomplete information system because of its incomplete original data. In view of the incomplete system, based on the analysis of variable rough set and set pair analysis, a new kind of generalized rough set based on set pair situation tolerance relation was proposed in this paper, and was used in the system modeling. By regulating and controlling the parameter ¿ to promise veracity and flexibility when marking up the productive condition attributes. Based on the proposed model, a cupidity algorithm of attribute significance was introduced and used to realize the productive condition attributes reduction and acquire the relative knowledge. The proposed model and algorithm were applied in the production and it shows the acquired knowledge with high rationality and validity can truly be to optimize the production process.

articleTitle: Antivibration analysis of anomalistic honeycomb paperboard
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Honeycomb paperboard has developed rapidly because of its hexagon core structure in casing area. One of the reasons is that honeycomb paper can prevent or lighten the vibration and concussion in the process of transportation. Existent anomalistic hexagon structure of the honeycomb paperboard has an impact on its antivibration characteristics. The antivibration effect of different anomalistic honeycomb paperboards are studied, offered certain theoretic direction to choose the appropriate structure of honeycomb paperboard. The method for antivibration analysis of honeycomb paper is help to analyze analogous materials and design new structure of honeycomb core.

articleTitle: An intelligent assistant design system based on CBR and MAS
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper establishes a framework of Multi-Agent System (MAS)-based collaborative assistant design system which is applied to the Machining Center (MC), provides an expanded Object-Oriented Knowledge Representation (OOKR) for the cases storage, presents an effective reasoning algorithm for the chosen of appreciate production type according to the customization, and illustrates a prototype case study to show the practicability of this system. Using this platform, a product model which has the greatest similarity with the customer order information can be proposed by encapsulated CBR intelligent searching strategy as quickly as possible. It can provide a stabile foundation for shorten the design cycle of new product development and improve a company's competitive ability in the dog-eat-dog market.

articleTitle: A research on the information communication method in SI design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, the space image construction of exclusive stores are paid great attention by the Chinese entrepreneurs In recent years, how to express the brand's inherent cultural concepts and national characteristic effectively have become the focus in academic and business circles during the process of the ¿Second upgrade of corporate visual image¿, and how to reflects psychological need of the crowd accurately. So the most important issue in this systematic project is to create a self- owned brand space image system, which possess profound cultural significances and distinctive national features. Furthermore, otherness signal information is scientific and reasonable, the research on the process and method of transmitting code could help the designers combine the received information together on the basis of nation culture, use different levels of design symbols coding rules, and get rid of some unnecessary information. Finally they will find the distinctive characteristics of the corporate brand image to enhance the brand culture and competitiveness.

articleTitle: Study on fitting gap between hinge shaft and bushing of earth-machinery's working mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: There are many hinge points in earth-machinery working mechanism. A reasonable gap between shaft and bushings is so important for the design of working mechanism design. This paper briefly analysed failure mechanism caused by irrationality selection on fittingting gap between hinge shaft and bushings of earth-machinery, such as hydraulic excavator working equipment. A new calculate theory and method on fittingting gap between hinge shaft and bushing was put forward. And the calculate method is proved by analyzing a certain excavator working equipment. The result shows that the method of determining the fittingting gap between hinge shaft and bushing is useful.

articleTitle: CAD modeling for tubes in industrial design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Tube surfaces are the complicated surfaces generated by smoothly joining together several cylinders. Most kinds of industrial design models are tube surfaces in production. To meet the needs of composite materials in some industrial design, it is necessary to make the representation of the tube surfaces as simple as possible. Based on the theory of implicit surface modeling, the global modeling methods for the tube surfaces of elbow and Y-tube are presented, the influences of parameters on the blending surfaces are discussed and the concave-convex characteristics of the blending surfaces and control surfaces are studied in this paper. On VC++ software platform, using Open Gl, the tube surfaces of elbow and Y-tube are implemented with a computer by the steps of gathering the data points from the implicit expressions, forming triangular mesh and fairing the triangular surfaces. The research results are very important for craft and technique of the products.

articleTitle: Primary probe of teaching reform in architecture design of the major of Environment Art
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Environment Art is a major that covers extensive fields. According to the characteristics of Environment art students, architectural design course will be offered in the teaching system of Environment Art, which make the students to better grasp the basic method of architectural design and lay a good foundation for the future of the environmental design that accordance with the architectural design.

articleTitle: Forming simulation system of 3-roll continual tube rolling PQF based on finite element method
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the PQF deformation process, a thermal-mechanical coupled model of this process is established by the three-dimensional elasto-plastic finite element method, and the visual simulation software of this process is generated with Visual Basic. Some important parameters such as the finished size of the rolled product, the temperature distribution of the tube, the rolling force of each roller are predict by utilizing this program. Comparison between simulation solutions and experiment results shows a good agreement, which means that the visual simulation software is capable of simulating PQF deformation process as well as forecasting product quality.

articleTitle: Research and implement of the training simulator for overhead cranes
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper introduced the research background and status of the training simulator for cranes, showed its function modules and system architecture. In terms of three different types of objects in the virtual scene, corresponsive modeling strategies for crane, material and environment were proposed. Moreover, based on VRML, the detail modeling methods for crane mechanism, crane structure, environment and materials were described. Finally, the interactive operating device of the training simulator was introduced and some applications were given.

articleTitle: Finite position method for complete balancing of shaking forces of mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Finite positions method is presented in this paper for complete balancing of shaking forces for planar and spatial mechanisms as well as the solutions to its equations. By using the method, only correctly formulated single-linked-chains (SOC) with proper connection and leaf components are needed to substitute into the equations to solve the parameters, which will be used to fully balance the shaking forces of planar mechanisms. The equations can be generated automatically. Furthermore, the equations are so flexible that they can solve the equilibrium of spatial mechanisms. This method can be applied to any complex planar or spatial mechanisms upon completion of positional analysis. It is easier than linearly independent vector method and has wider range of applications. In the end, the detailed steps of the method are given for solving planar single loop four-bar(RRRR and RRRT), planar double loop six-bar(RRRRRT), and spatial single loop(RSCR) mechanisms.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the artistic features of Chopin Nocturne Op.48 Nr1
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A method for modeling conceptual design with irregular surface
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A new method of fast modeling conceptual model with irregular complicated surfaces is presented for fast and good design. Based on a poly surface that is transferred from a NURBS surface, the 3-D model is established through a 2-D image corresponding to the conceptual complicated surface utilizing the opacity and displacement processes, also with the surface adjustment of Surface Mapper(WSM)-3D Max commend. Experimental results show that this method of modeling can achieve the conceptual model with irregular complicated surfaces in a short time and with less data quantity.

articleTitle: Discussion on design of baby changing station in public place
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the widely using of baby changing station in the public place, its usability is considered greatly important. It is necessary to give convenience in the behavior of nursing for both baby and adult. Through analyzing baby's psychological characteristics in the adult's nursing behavior, the main features of using baby changing station are researched and analyzed. At last some key factors about how to design baby changing station for public place are concluded in the paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of nipper mechanism on comber with high damping aluminum alloy
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The objective of this paper is to study the effect of high damping aluminum alloy on dynamic stability of Nipper Mechanism, in order to improve its stability of motion. Based on Euler-Bernoulli beam theory, the partial differential equation of motion with damping was formulated. According to Floquent theory, Galerkin's method and Fourier series method were then applied to obtain the stable and instable boundaries by FORTRAN programming. The results show that the locations of instability regions considering damping are the same to those without damping, and the damping influence the width of instability regions which become narrower with damping increasing, till disappearance. Therefore, high damping aluminum alloys play an important role in the dynamic stability of Nipper Mechanism.

articleTitle: Ecological art research on landscape architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The design of landscape is a way of thoughts on disposaling the manmade environment and natural environment, which is also a sort of modern scientific knowledge mixed by many others, it has the double face between subjective and objective, including concrete form of ecology & the abstract form of ecology, Modern design of landscape is not only to satisfy the need of people, but also to search a harmonious relationship among all the life. And the main clues in the passage will be to research the design of landscape as a best one, how it can be sustainable development, by which to provide a comfortable and beautiful living condition.

articleTitle: The innovation and inheritance of art &design basic education
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Development and changing of the era will inevitably bring the inheritance and evolution of thinking and behavior mode. While the concept of modern art design education is also in a dynamic propulsion mode, previously considered antithetical ideals are gradually becoming fusion and unified. The new era of development and evolution is gradually facilitating the separation between education of art design and traditional art. How to better inherit and innovate fundamental art design education is one of the major issues which modern design schools are generally facing. Only by strengthening the students' innovative thinking training in teaching and emphasizing their designing concept presentation in exercising, and consequently make students complete the sublimation from perceptual to rational, can students transit from simple representation of the object to art design specialty modeling essence.

articleTitle: The sculpturing of aesthetic feeling about the product form based on the users' aesthetic levels
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: From the esthetic aspects of the users,this article mainly proposes the design method of the product form esthetic feeling that is based on the users' aesthetic levels. There are three levels to the users aesthetic feeling: The aesthetic feeling level X conveys the visual order and simplification of form, the Y aesthetic feeling express the product's purpose, function,the thought communication or intention, while the Z aesthetic feeling is closely correlated with the fashion, style, and individual taste and culture. Owing to this three arrangement of aesthetic feeling characteristic, the designers could purposefully build esthetic feeling based on these three levels, On the first stage he can choose the designing method such as utilizing the specially form element and applying the rules of form aesthetic to mold the form order and the integrity of products; designer could also sculpture the product aesthetic feeling in the levels of function and operability, mold the product culture by various design method, arouse spiritual resonance to user in culture and values, we sculptures aesthetic feeling for product form thereby.

articleTitle: The discussion of the development trend on terminal visualized image design of dress brand
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, started with the theory of the visualized marketing science and exhibition design, adopted the method of combining the theory with the instances, the effect on the terminal visualized design of the dress band is analyzed, which includes the lifecycle of the stores design, the goods display and culture atmosphere of the stores. It also is discussed that the function of the modern media and the new communication means on the terminal visualized design of the dress band.

articleTitle: Study of new digital media arts
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the development of science and technology, digitalization has infiltrated into different aspects of our daily life. The brand-new digital media supported by computers, Internet and multi-media technology is flurishingly rising. This paper mainly illustrate some basic knowledge of the definition of digital new media, the interaction and visuality of digital new media. It also put forward some reflections on the future development of digital media.

articleTitle: A computer designing approach for generation of controllable porosity in the bone scaffold
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Building bone scaffold with controllable pore size is important. This paper presents a new design approach of internal structure in order to simulate pore character of the natural bone in the bone scaffold. A parametric structure of unit cell is used as the basic unit to build internal architecture. There are three types of global unit assembly paths in this method. Different linear control functions can be applied in each path to control the size changing of the pore of unit cells, which can be used to realize various typical macro distribution of porosity in the bone scaffold..

articleTitle: Computer aided multi-form design based on morph technology
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper, aiming to improve the traditional design process, proposes a method that designers provide a basic conceptual form scheme of the products, but a detailed form is modified by the users according to the locally changeable two or three dimensional models released on the internet, and the needed several product form schemes can be achieved through statistic analysis of the feedbacks from the users. In this process, users redesign the shape in the mean while of product evaluation, which makes the users have a good knowledge of the products and makes the designers get the direct statistics of the most desirable morph from the perspective of the users. This method combines the form evaluation and design together, which is able to promote the communication between design and evaluation, thus to make design more efficient. The users' evaluations are not vague language or figures any longer but are realized through simple diagram modification, which makes the evaluation more feasible and reflects the real needs of the users.

articleTitle: The research on the human oriented design of digital guiding system in public space
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: On the basis of the deep analysis of the nature of the human oriented design of digital guiding system in public space, this paper put forward the point of view as ¿hit you with the emotion; touch you with the love; unite you with the concept¿, and present the tendency of the development of the human oriented design of the digital guiding system.

articleTitle: A research on the willingness of consuming
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to literature review and a number of market research, there is an analysis about the characteristics of the domestic fragrance market. And then through the research on the consumption habits and attitudes, the result of qualitative and quantitative analysis based on the Logistic Model concludes the impact of the factors in four aspects on the willingness of purchasing perfume. According to the result the market could be divided into 6 segmentations. And the target group could be discovered in further research.

articleTitle: A biomechanical analysis of electric nursing care beds basing on a virtual man-bed system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Relation between human and electric care beds (ECB) is complex and special. This study aims at reducing incidence of ulcer and improve comfort when using ECB. To quantify the force distribution exerted upon human body in process of following the care beds for a long period and evaluate the feasibility of new functions of care beds, a group of old people were asked to finish a series of experiments on three kinds of electric care beds. Pressure mapping system and a virtual man-bed system were utilized to quantify the forces in all postures and assess the influences of postures and body weight, explore the relationship between bed movement and force distribution. The results can be utilized to improve the pathological characteristics of ECB in all postures, and furthermore to evaluate or predict the feasibility of new functions added to electric nursing care beds.

articleTitle: Concept design of furniture based on the delight-orientation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Concept design, which is currently quite fashionable, has almost permeated all areas of design, furniture design included certainly. Based on the principle of humanity and ecologization, this paper was mainly from the point of delight-orientation and personality to discuss the concept design of the furniture, in order to bring people a sophisticated living space, meeting their spiritual demands.

articleTitle: The importance of computer hand painting to the product design ideation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The design is an open process of reflection. It not only needs to display the final achievement by the concrete and visual way, but also cannot leave the analysis and compares the graphical representation in the process of ideation. Each designer's originality and idea condenses much painstaking care. It needs the designer to consider carefully how to express the unique idea objectively. The spark of inspiration of an innovative design comes from the repeated collisions between the negation and affirmation. Hand painting may catch this kind of the spark of inspiration rapidly. However, today, as the computer technology is popular and increasingly refined, rapidly penetrated into all fields of science, it has became a new trend to using the DIGITIZER and the computer into the hand-painted design and expression. Moreover the computer hand painting is helpful to call for new design ideas, reduces the design cycle, and the design is easy to control, revise and regenerate, then the actual efficiency is greatly raised.

articleTitle: The shaping of the spiritual environment and sustainable development in the design of modern urban settlements
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid urban development and expansion, a large number of residential quarters have emerged out. But the designs of these settlements are following the same pattern, with the disadvantages of lacking of resistance and environmental characteristics. This paper analyzes the relationship between the construction of settlements in the design and the context, stresses the importance of shaping the spiritual environment in the settlements and its possible solutions, and proposes the introduction of the concept of sustainable development in designing the settlements and the trend of modern settlements.

articleTitle: Algorithm of female's non-contact somatometry system based on 2-dimensional pictures
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: 540 female were measured by using photo and manual measuring methods. Among these people there are 317 young and 223 elder. By using the Matlab program, female's frontal and sided pictures were extracted and the outlines were got, from which the relevant height, thickness and width values could be drawn. Then construct the fitted equation of circumference by linear regression equation in two unknowns, through that the purpose of female's non-contract technique of measurement based on 2-dimensional pictures can be realized. In order to improve the accuracy of measurement, the ratios of characteristic points' height to body height in this system were divided while the ratio of thick to width was also divided, then for each grade, the algorithmic system were respectively established. Confirmatory analysis results show that the data got from the algorithmic system are credible.

articleTitle: A full database supported strategy for the software development of engineering production design and analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A full database supported strategy is presented for the software development of integration design and analysis of engineering productions. The strategy resolves the elements of engineering design and analysis as a solver and five supporters. The solver embraces all the used scientific methods, approaches, and measurements logically, digitally, and numerically. The supporters are databases for supporting the solver. They are Prototype-F for reserving functional, constructive and geometric parameterization prototypes; Material-S for material and structure metallurgical, physical, static mechanical, fatigued, and fractured parameters; Loads for service conditions including loads and environments obtained from expected design, on-line inspection, and numerical simulations; Criteria for code based criteria and the customer's requirements; and History for historic successful and failure events. Any of information in the databases is step-by-step called by the solver to match the process of production design and analysis by an independent and flexible interface. The software is then developed by combining software engineering, data engineering, and knowledge engineering to form an innovation software environment of Re-usability, High efficiency, Flexibility, and adaptability. The software information can be multiplied and strengthened days and months. And the functions can be perfected itself as the time increase. Feasibility has been indicated by the software platform development for China high speed motor unit reliability design and analysis.

articleTitle: The way of automotive 3-D styling based on digital hand sketching
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper has investigated the approaches of automotive 3-D styling based on the hand sketching with Wacom<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> Cintiq 21UX digital screen. By the analysis of curve modeling tools for the current CAD systems used broadly in automotive industry, the easier, more intuitive and more convenient 3-D styling approaches are discussed. The stylist can change the curves with modified strokes during the sketching in a natural way of painting. The combination of strokes can be achieved automotively. Some features are also proposed to realise those approaches.

articleTitle: The research on Human-Power Vehicles for local transport
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The aim of this study is to present the findings and discuss the research into Third-Agers' needs in and attitudes toward using the cycle as a means of local transport. It identifies opinions about using Human-Power Vehicles among Third-Agers' particularly those opinions that can be improved through emphasis on ‘transgeneration design’ in product development.

articleTitle: Research on user experience design of household fridge
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper summarizes the key elements in the fridge design based on the analysis of the concept and connotation of the user experience design, and the methods to express each kind of elements are put forward. The trend of fridge design in the future is predicted with the help of the classification of various experience elements, which provides a reference to the research on the experience design theory and the fridge design. Moreover, the theory proposed in this paper, which is combining the user experience design theory with the fridge design, is also useful to other design applications such as the household appliance design and so on.

articleTitle: Material language and painting characteristic expression of modern lacquer painting
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Considering the significance of material in modern lacquer painting, this thesis illuminates modern lacquer painting characteristics as well as its epoch semantics and context change with material language transformation and artistic expression freedom to materialize the spiritual value of material language and painting characteristic expression of modern lacquer painting.

articleTitle: Design of the terminal of Split-type PCs
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: As we enter the Information Age, as the main tool for information transmission' Computers are playing so important roles in people's lives that they have become irreplaceable sometimes. Yet most of the personal computer users are far from versed in computer using. It is common phenomenon that they usually take personal computers as another kind of domestic appliances. This, unavoidably lead to the monotony of personal computer using. This makes it very difficult for personal computers to show and perform their full function. The introduction of media center computers has in a certain extent facilitated people's using experience of computers by enabling them to use personal computers in a much easier way at any time. Such as music video players, computer games, network applications etc. Still there is long way to go before media center computers reach the point to bring in a breakthrough in the field of personal computer using and even to revolutionize personal computer using under the domestic circumstance. On this base, we put forward the concept of the design of split-type personal computer terminals under the domestic circumstance.

articleTitle: The theory of computer supported cooperative work applying in product design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the emergence of global markets competition and customized products, collaborative product design combining computer technology has been applied to a certain extent. This paper discusses the background and definition of computer supported collaborative design of products, summed up several typical patterns of co-design according to its main content and basic characteristics and have made an in-depth analysis, finally expatiates on the application and development prospects of computer supported collaborate design products to promote its further use in China.

articleTitle: On construction of national industrial design Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The construction of the National Innovation System is of great significance to the enhancement of a nation's comprehensive competitiveness. The value of the National Innovation System should be manifested through various channels with the application of certain competitive elements. Industrial Design can provide competitive advantages to both enterprises and the national economy. It is the nation's core creativity in the sense of material culture and one of the key elements of the competitive strength. Design innovation program from the national level is in accordance to the National Innovation System, so it is an integral part and a sub-system of the National Innovation system. The efficacy of the Industrial Design Innovation System originates from the initiatives of enterprises and the full play of all system platforms.

articleTitle: Discussion on regional culture and interior design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Regional culture combined interior design is popular in the modern design. Regional culture combined interior design becomes a visual methodology. This manner make a lot of people study and inherit the history, regional culture. In this paper, some excellent cases with regional design are discussed. The facing problem and the reason are described. Author proposes the way to create personalize regional design.

articleTitle: A boundary identification method for 3D closed triangle mesh
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A boundary identification algorithm for the hole of 3D closed triangle mesh is presented in this paper. The region of interest is selected by mouse dragging. Combine with the continuous hole silhouette obtain by the dot product between the triangle normal and the viewing direction we can find the 3D hole boundary of the outer surface. The other hole boundary can be searched according to the curve point set and the hole silhouette. This algorithm can simplify the interactive operation for the identification of the hole boundaries on the model which is a 2-manifold, oriented, closed and non-simple connected triangle mesh and improve the efficient of relative geometric design system.

articleTitle: Research on the virtual 3D Human -computer Interaction based on the 3G terminal cross-platform
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The three-dimensional (3D) human-computer interaction of the wireless mobile communication is becoming the research highlight in the field of the human-computer interaction. As the terminal products of the third generation (3G) wireless communication, the mobile phones, the PDA (personal digital assistant) and etc directly contact the end users, the modal of the content provided and the comfort level of the users are determined by the human-computer interaction, which also further influence weather the users' satisfaction, therefore the product survival in the market. The new virtual human-computer interaction technology of 3G mobile communication terminal is explored and studied based on mentioned above in this paper.

Author Keywords: The Three-dimensional (3D) Human-computer Interaction of the wireless mobile communication

articleTitle: Study on design management of brand building
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Analyzed the development and changes of product and design in immaterial society, pointed out that brand had become one of the important parts of product's immaterial intensions, and brand building shouldn't be limited in sales department, on the contrary it should be put into the whole product development process. Only with efficient design and design management, can brand building succeed. Along with the concept of design management, studied on the general pattern of brand building and the primary implement steps, analyzed the key phases in detail, and reflected on the main working contents and the general procedure of brand design management. Based on that, analyzed the brand building process of SONY, and discussed four key issues particularly.

articleTitle: Study on methods and strategies of product innovative design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The product innovative design comprehensively reflects the economy, technology and culture of certain times. On the basis of studying the elements of technology, culture and population of the product design process and the analysis of the existing rules and inter-links of the three elements, concrete methods and strategies of the enterprise product innovative design are given, which provide the basis for new breakthroughs in product design.

articleTitle: Study of building virtual human body model based on SolidWorks
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtual human body model is important of the products for the ergonomics optimization design. In this paper, a virtual human body model was built using SolidWorks software. The function “configuration manager” in SolidWorks makes serial rebuilding of virtual human body models easy without reimporting the models with different dimensions many times. Therefore, it becomes efficient and convenient for ergonomics optimization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Brief discussion on visual culture & design patterns of “The Analects Jade Candle”
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The manifestation of organic modernism style in interior design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Throughout the history of the development of interior design, respect for nature and concern about humanity have always been the subjects of it. Organic modernism style conquers the whole world with its powerful vitality and practicability. By the interpretation of the design philosophy of organic design style, we can distinguish the pure motivation of design with great clarity and find the development trend of interior design profoundly.

articleTitle: Mechanical engineering control system for the linear time delay with disturbances
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Predictive model following control mechanical engineering control system can output general signals following the desired ones. In this paper, a method of predictive system will be extended to be a design of linear system with time-delay. The bounded property of the internal states for the control is given and the utility of this control design is guaranteed. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study the application of workflow in contribute system based on ASP model
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Along with the development of Internet and WEB Technology, Many academic journals have established their work Website on the Internet, using WEB-based contribute system to deal with manuscripts. But many small academic journals which affiliates to higher education of the local government have no enough financial resource. They cannot afford to purchase or develop such system. In addition, to go over a manuscript, the work flow may not be the same in academic journals. To solve these problems, we proposed the application of workflow technology in contribute system which is based on Application Service Provider Model, and gave the related model.

articleTitle: Research on the visualization design of fighter cockpit integrated display interface
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: From the functional design and emotional design of Information visualization, the consistency and experience design objectives of the visualization design of fighter cockpit integrated display are put forward. The specific strategies of achieving the two goals also are expounded. Pointed to the transform from the abstract, non-visual characteristics of the information into a visible, easy-to-understand interface, two methods of interface metaphor and ecological interface are discussed.

articleTitle: The creative industry has came
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Outside the field of traditional design, originality has been playing a role that resolves design problem, with provide a special creative angle of view and innovative thinking, it provides a perfect solution for Customer's demands. Though the design industry has already been aware of this change from design business, the role change of designer for customer and a lot of increasing opportunities in future, the tremendous changes which the developmental tendency bring on are still much greater than what they be aware of.

articleTitle: Primary investigation of machine tool's appearance modeling design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Machine tool has been evolved for thousands of years from the birth of the first one to the wide application of numerical control machine tool. It has been experienced from the beginning in simple function with man powered to the development in implementing multi function with machine power, and to the emerging of the numerical control machine tool. And their application fields are more and more extensive; their process precisions are even higher. The materials which are used to consist of the machine tool were developed from wood, iron, steel and alloy, nonmetal material with the properties of much lighter, preferable mechanical performances, and to pay more attention on materials by environmental protection and sustainable. The exterior appearance model of the machine tool were designed from the beginning in tousy appearance and without any protection parts to employ diversity and individuation designing style with streamline idea, modernism idea and post-modernism. The exterior color of the machine tool were varied from the early in wood manner without color to black, grey, and to now meet the customer mental needs which are put into pairs with multi-color. Individuation, diversification and emotion are more reflected in modern color design of the machine tool. It is very important and useful to investigate the development process of machine tool from the construction, consist of materials, exterior appearance, and color design etc., to forecast the development trends of the exterior appearance model of machine tool for the future machine tool design.

articleTitle: Geometric model reconstruction of the real human upper respiratory tract for compute simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the voxels with the highest density, the human upper airway is constructed from a normal adult male computed tomography images by Maximum Intensity Projections (MIP) in this paper. The Volume Rendering Technique (VRT) is adopted in the research. The different organ is distinguished by their density, i.e. image gray. ). In order to reduce the data processing time and save the software and hardware resources, the size of block data is changed before mass data processing by discarding data without containing information content. The obtained geometric model is used to computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of airflow and particle transport, the computation accuracy and reliability is greatly enhanced. Furthermore, the experimental model based the obtained model using Laser Rapid Prototyping Manufacture (LRPM) technology is designed and conducted.

articleTitle: The accelerating implementation of BLAST with stream processor
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Sequence alignment is one of the most fundamental and important operation in bioinformatics. Through sequence alignment, we can find the sequence's information of function, structure and evolution. BLAST is one of the most popular algorithms in the field of sequence alignment. In this paper, we have designed a GPU-based parallel BLAST algorithm and implemented it on the brook<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> platform. The main task is to parallel the construction of words lists procedure and the match-expansion procedure. As for match-expansion procedure, we designed two ways to parallelize it including internal parallelism and mixed parallelism. According to results of experiments based on AMD's HD4850, we got more than 3x gains on parallel implementing the procedure of construction of words list and the implementation of internal parallelism respectively compared with CPU-based implementations. Besides, we got more than 4x gains for mixed parallelism as well. Furthermore, the experiments verified that the procedure of reading and writing data through PCI-E was the bottleneck of AMD's GPU applications.

articleTitle: Market operation and development of commodities packaging redesign
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The victory of commodity packaging in the market competition depends on redesign for the purpose of a planned commodity packaging. This article focus on the argument about the specific aspects of packaging redesigns process. Based on the original packaging, combined with the fine tradition of the succession of elements and new cultural trends, conduct investigations in-depth about current consumer psychology and the new packaging design of products in the market competition can win and lead a new aesthetic trend.

articleTitle: Function principle structure model for conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Product is a physical system comprising interacting components that performs a set of functions. The product design is a process from abstract to concrete. In product conceptual design phase, function is one of the most important factors. Function-based modelling makes design problem modular and structured. It is the basis of the following detail design in product lifecycle design process. In this paper, function of product is decomposed into sub-functions or function-cells. These sub-functions or function-cells are combined into the product's original model. Accordingly, function principle structure model is generally used to represent functional requirement formally in conceptual design process. The construction of Function principle structure model is an important task in product conceptual design phase. In this paper, a new function principle structure model for conceptual design is proposed. According to the principle of function decomposition, the function principle structure model is constructed.

articleTitle: Innovation design of aerosol spray cans
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Innovation design is the core strategy in the business competition, and the main purpose of which is to incentive the special preferences of consumers. Thus, consumers can be successfully stimulated to purchase. The major objective of this paper is to investigate the method to enhance the competitiveness of manufacturing enterprises by differentiation strategy, which including design concept, molding-making design, decoration design, and so on. The authors deeply discuss and research on molding-making design of aerosol spray cans. The innovative design is conducted in accordance with the theory of differentiation, which is integrated well into the shapes of aerosol spray cans.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on culture differences in emotional designing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Product form design and analyzing on image expression
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper discusses the elements about product form design, function, Ergonomics, Aesthetics, and the relation between them, and analyzes their influence on each other through the research on the elements of Power Tools. Through exploring the best course of combination of the elements of products (form, color, material, Ergonomics), it will help to do form design based on Image Expression.

articleTitle: Research on the forming speech in the draw-forming of the sheet
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to analysing the simulation done by the software ETA/Dynaform instead of experiments, the rules, which indicate the influence of the conditions to the forming speed, are summarized. The whole forming process was controlled through adjusting the blank holder force (BHF), stamping speed and the friction coefficients varied with time. It provides a theory basic to choose the reasonable parameters to improve the quality of drawing parts, shorten the cycle of mould design and prolong the life of the die.

articleTitle: The innovation of design education-design education based on CO-OP system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The design education which is of great significance to the whole society is gradually spreaded and rapidly developed now. According to the problems appearing in the development of design education in China, this paper proposed the innovation of design education system which is based on CO-OP system. It also provides a detailed introduction on the characteristics of the CO-OP system, as well as the concrete implementation of this system in the design teaching.

articleTitle: User mental model of hypermedia system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Within the broad field of human-computer interaction, concept of mental model has long been employed in the discussion and design of hypermedia system. Although still with varying interpretations, it is now sufficiently important to warrant a formal and precise deifnition. In this article, an overview is presented of related works in user's mental model of hypermedia system over the last 20 years. These works include the topology of hypermedia system, a framework for navigation in hypermedia system and user's schemata measurement. Inevitably, much must be omitted, but the referenced papers may fill some of the gaps. Finally, after summarizing the four aspects of study on mental model, a conclusion and some of the future study opportunities are noted.

articleTitle: Custom-made design of the unloading highly equipment of loader with the Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: For opening widely the use of loader and meet the needs of customs, the unloading highly equipment of loader was custom-made designed by genetic algorithms on the basis of normal ZL50 wheel one. In order to reduce the costs and improve the spare parts in common use, only a few spare parts in unloading equipment are redesigned and others remain unchanged. After calculation and analysis, it is showed that the unloading highly equipment of loader is in accord with the design request and available for customer.

articleTitle: Redefine the meaning of Lamp Design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This article is a redefinition for the meaning of Lamp Design. Lamp is a carrier of light. And designers try to find special materials, supporters and forms to get a proper light strength, light colour and light direction in order to find an exit for light to break the darkness. The whole part of Lamp is unscrambled into 3 parts, that is the inside part, the support part and the wrap part. The support part pass through the wrapping part and connect the inside part and also with easy button to control the light on or off. The wrap part is to hide or partly hide the strong inside part, the light source, in order to be effectively used according to our request. If we change any part of the lamp, we may find a new way to find an exit for light. Thus a new lamp turns out. Also some excellent examples are given here to support the idea and finally some new designs are shown here as well.

articleTitle: Research on transfer control strategy in CNC high-speed and high-accuracy machining
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Feed rate has always been one of the most important indicators for CNC performance, while transfer velocity between two adjacent segments pays a key role in improving feed rate. Since the contour of a special part commonly consists of line and arc segments (non-micro segments), as well as continuous micro line segments (micro segments) so there should be different methods to deal with their transfer velocity, respectively. In this paper, a new two-pass algorithm is proposed to find the optimal transfer velocity for micro segments. The theory of machining links and several constraints are developed to drive the algorithm. Then, a vector transfer algorithm is generated to realize transfer for non-micro segments, the generated algorithm is based on s-curve and added to a new optimization algorithm to constrain the velocity, acceleration and jerk at the turning corner. Finally, several examples are presented to illustrate the application of above two algorithms.

articleTitle: Illusionary effect of clothing symbols
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The relationship between clothing and the wearer has always been a focal point of cultural perspectives. As a communicated media in non-verbal forms, clothing and adornment not only can show an illusionary selfhood, but also hide the characteristics of ontology, form a new self-image. This paper based on the cultural point of view of clothing, and placed the clothing symbol on the aesthetics, sociology and psychology background, and analytic the illusion effect of clothing symbols. This brought new questions to clothing culture, to guide deep-level thinking and wider perspective.

articleTitle: Structure optimization for link suspension system of a 180t BOF vessel
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The link suspension system has been used to install a BOF vessel shell in the trunnion ring and has been adopted widely in many steelmaking workshops all over the world. This system is a key component of the oxygen steelmaking process and combines the advantages of well-proven suspension systems with the design philosophy of static determinacy in any operating condition and status of deformation. Recent researches and publications focus on the application of the system and rarely involve in the design mechanics of the system. This paper describes an investigation into the load of link using ADAMS to model the tilting process of BOF. The factors of influencing the link load are also discussed. The indications are that the distribution and parameters of the vertical and the horizontal links have great impact on the laws of loads. An optimization model including these parameters has been constructed to obtain a reasonable load distribution of these links. The optimization results show that vertical links should be assembled vertically and distributed uniformly along circumference of the trunnion ring to reduce theoretically the link loads.

articleTitle: Design of drug packaging for the old
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: With the arrival of an aging society, and the average period of ill for the old is much longer than the period of health, at the same time, there are various drugs and difficult dosage for the old, while there are adverse information recognition on drug packaging, coupled with the old special physiological and psychological characteristics, all of which must make the old forget or make a mistake in taking medicine, or even excessive taking, and other life-threatening problems. The article research the design of drug packaging for the old, in order to improve the security and convenience of taking medicine for the old, through analysis of the importance of information security and the physical characteristics of users.

articleTitle: Lay-up design and structural analysis of 1.2MW composite wind turbine blade
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: According to theoretical calculating result of stress, four different lay-up structures of 1.2 MW horizontal axis wind turbine blade, which can effectively endure various loads, are designed primarily. Based on composite laminate theory and finite element method, through analyzing their stress-strain, the optimal lay-up schema is confirmed. The verified analysis of stiffness and strength were performed under extreme load conditions. Numerical analysis results show that the designed blade structure was safe, and the value of stress and strain was low.

articleTitle: Research on visualization technology and information management system for collaborative production development
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: A novel product data management mode, CVPDS (Collaborative Visualization Production Development System), which is based on the cooperative design and visualization technology, is proposed in this paper. It also analyzes and establishes the system frame, discusses the key technology of cooperative visualization development and the implementing management flat; studies the realization method of 3D virtual modeling based on network, the information visualization and so on, and then, proves the feasibility and the practicability of the CVPDS by the development and preliminary application of a prototype system, which gives a useful research on resource sharing and interactive technology under the advanced manufacturing mode.

articleTitle: Study of the application of meta-fractal graphics design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Meta-fractal design is the new method and idea of graphic design. By utilizing the fractal self-similarity principle and using the definition of function or software extraction process, we may extract the relatively independent unit-meta-fractal in which to a certain extent contains the basic information and characteristics of the whole fractal graph. By utilizing computer CAD software and following aesthetic rules, meta-fractal can be developed into a variety of pattern designs.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Innovation design and optimization scheme of the BF-type flexible drive in using
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Initial exploration of Escher's regular plane figures
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, regular plane figures in Escher's art works were explored from the angle of the relationship with mathematics. The figures were classified by three types: regularly filling, infinitely expressing, gradually dynamic expressing, and three basic principles of the design of Escher's regular plane figures were put forward: using shared lines, drawing as saw tooth-like, symmetrically coloring, and therefore the enlightenment was revealed from Escher's regular plane figures to the modern visual artistic design.

articleTitle: The humanized service designs of dress brand terminal
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The humanized service designs of dress brand terminal become one of the key factors for success in dress market because of the dress production homogenization. The humanized service designs include the designs of sales environment, cash register and information desk and the fitting rooms, air conditions, fragrance, background music etc. The favorable terminal-serving environment represents the style and taste of brand, and has the active effect on the value and image of brand.

articleTitle: Discussion on future design trend of children's chair in Chinese restaurant
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper investigate and analysis the psychological state and the basic physiological characteristics of children and analysis the situation of children's chair in the domestic and international market; illustrate the type and the advantage and disadvantage of children's chair by mixed forms, focus on the classification of famous foreign brand of children's chair and with this as the baseline of evaluation. In this paper put forward the design trends of children's chair in future by evaluating the typical products in today's market using the method of survey and combine with the characteristic of Chinese restaurant.

articleTitle: Creative design of intelligent children furniture
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: To be intelligent will be a new trend of furniture in the future. This paper defined the intelligent children furniture, analyzed the creative elements and some new methods of it. Especially studied on a new methods called functional module method and made a detailed analysis on its design process. The aim is to provide some new methods and ideas to furniture designers and enterprises.

articleTitle: Collaborative humanized design of NC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Humanized design has become a mainstream of product design. By analyzing three levels about humanized design of NC machine tools, this paper reveals the salient features involved in the collaborative process of humanized design. By studying the present design system of collaborative models of NC machine tools, this paper analyses how to further embed and expand collaborative humanized design of NC machine tools from establishing the professional knowledge base, building platform of interaction and experience & evaluation.

articleTitle: The structural analysis based on modern design method
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Our traditional design is mainly based on producing experiences according to mechanical and mathematical formulas, diagrams, manuals and so on. Therefore, the finished product is functional but long design period and high cost are required. Nowadays, various modern design methods are more and more applied. The methods help to avoid aimless and random of the empirical design, to increase design scientificity, to bring down development cost, to shorten developing period and to improve product's quality. This paper presents based on the modern design methods of finite element method and virtual prototype technology how to build parameterized three-dimensional material model of mechanical system by means of three-dimensional modeling software, UG, how to apply ADAMS, a dynamics virtual prototype software of mechanical system, to build rigid body model, how to establish Model Neutral File of flexible body components by means of finite element method software, ANSYS, and how to build flexible body model by means of ADAMS. It also presents when force and constraint are applied to each component, modal analysis of multi-body system dynamics three-dimensional visible intensity and vibration is undertaken and modal mode and frequency are inspected. This paper researches the initial attempt of applying advanced design, analysis and simulation techniques in design of ships crane. It also offers some feasible experiences and methods for the virtual design, dynamic design and structure virtual analysis of ships crane.

articleTitle: Mobile-C based agent management for collaborative visualization of distributed mesh model
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Collaborative working during product design is highly desired to the modern globalized industry. Multi-agent system (MAS) technology is widely used to manage artificial intelligence of distributed system. Effective mechanism for self-organization of agents is important to MAS system. In this paper, a mobile-C based agent management is introduced and applied into a collaborative visualization of product mesh models among distributed designers. This collaborative visualization environment helps to realize information exchange and cooperative visualization of product model during complex concurrent processes. A prototype is developed through a collaborative mesh simplification process.

articleTitle: User-Centered & Experience Design trend overview
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Recently, User-Centered & Experience Design increasingly became the latest trend in all kinds of designs. Not only Intelligent Buildings but also new applications in Facebook, or new Iphone games, or digital equipments which help the disabled to participate in social activities and support children learning. Edges of traditional designs are disappearing. Functional factors of designs are reducing. User-Centered & Experience Design has become a new spotlight.

articleTitle: Ship hull automatic optimization techniques research based on CFD
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
