abstract: Network singers, a group of musical people with network as their major communicative media, are a new kind of art forces with the full development of people's personality in modern society and the increasing popularity of new media—network. The rising of network singers have brought great impact on Chinese music and song. This paper has explored the reasons of the rising of Chinese network singers and their great impact on Chinese art circles from the following three aspects: ideas from the community, network technology and the environment of arts.

articleTitle: A study on environment color simulation of surroundings of CG characters in live-action scene
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this study is to expore a realistic looking result in the digital compositing. Realistic visual representation through digital compositing is influenced by various aspects and factors. This research is based on a study of environment colors, which explored and simulated daylight colors and colors reflected from the surroundings of characters in a live action scene filmed by cameras. The main goal of the project ¿Octopus¿ is to support the scope of the theory of this study. In this study, we have examined a number of diverse examples taken from the real world.

articleTitle: A study on knowledge fermentation based on RP during the course of product creative design
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: Knowledge becomes the most important strategic resource of product creative design. Knowledge fermentation based on RP is that new creativity (knowledge) becomes a physical prototype which full of new knowledge under the control of RP(knowledge enzyme) in the environment of constitute of Rapid Prototype technology platform and creative design system. Knowledge fermentation model is established according to the theory of biotic fermentation. The similarity of these two kinds of fermentation is compared. The intrinsic mechanism and general regulation of knowledge activities are analysed during the course of product development based on RP. RP (knowledge enzyme) can promote efficiently the knowledge digest, convert, increase and spread during the course of knowledge fermentation through example.

articleTitle: Real-time Google Earth 3D assisted driving system in surface mining operations
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: To improve the mine haul trucks operating safety in surface mining, a novel driving assisted system based on the GPS, mesh-wireless networks, and the Google-Earth API was developed. It has the capability to pin-point and track vehicles in real time using a 3D interface, which is based on user-based AutoCAD mine maps using the Google-Earth graphics interface. The research results indicate that it increases reliability and reduces uncertainty in surface mining operations by customizing the local 3D digital mining map, constructing the truck 3D models, tracking vehicles, warning proximity dangers and indicating available escape routes.

articleTitle: Research and development of the software on computer-aided fixtures designing
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The design of the machine tool fixture is very common in technical design. The purpose of the present research is to improve the efficiency of fixture design with the help of computer-aided fixture design. Examples of the fixture-design software development based on the AutoCAD platform are introduced. From the perspective of engineers, problems during the process of fixture design are discussed. The standardization of fixture design is also discussed.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent method of generating virtual landscape along high-speed passenger dedicated rail line
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: It is an important research topic to do the landscape design and evaluation, especially the pre-assessment, of high-speed passenger dedicated rail line effectively. This paper discusses the feasibility and necessity of using VR (virtual reality) technology to evaluate the high-speed railway landscape design comprehensively. For the rail line and ancillary facilities being the primary target of landscape design for high-speed railway, the building methods of them are studied in the first place. Based on an integrated analysis of the virtual landscape elements along high-speed rail line, a hierarchical structure of the landscape along the line is built, and a model database of ancillary facilities is established. Furthermore, with OpenFlight database, a standard data formats as a tool, the intelligent generation method of 3D rail track model is achieved. Then, using the Instances and External References and operating model data files through OpenFlight API's programming interface, the generation of ancillary facilities environment is accomplished.

articleTitle: Contemporary nature of lead wire language in modern lacquer painting
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: In view of the significance of material in modern lacquer painting, the thesis, with material characteristics and esthetic charms of lead wire as well as its material language transformation in modern lacquer painting, demonstrates the material language context and esthetic preference of lead wire in modern lacquer painting so as to display contemporary nature of modern lacquer painting and achieve naturalness and freedom of artistic spirit from respect and return of esthetic value of lead wire, simplicity and pureness of esthetic expression, naturalness and freedom of artistic spirit, and so on.

articleTitle: Effect of material parameters on dendritic patterns of Ni-Cu binary alloy using phase-field simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: The effects of various material parameters such as solid diffusivity Ds, anisotropy parameter ¿, interface kinetic coefficient ß, surface energy ¿ and cooling rate T on dendritic patterns are investigated by using a phase-field model which couples concentration gradient for three-dimensional simulation of binary alloy solidification. The computed results indicate that, different material parameters lead to different dendritic patterns and severity of microsegregation. The smaller the Ds is, as well as the larger the ¿, ß, ¿, T are, the greater the dendritic tip velocity is, the more developed both the main branch and side-branches are, and the bigger DAS is.

articleTitle: A study on the model of design leadership strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE 10th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design
abstract: All the leading products and services, such as iPod and Sony Walkman, are the practices of design-led strategy firms. Design is in the center of business value generation and sustainable competitive advantage. The general perception of design is that it is about creating something that looks capability or larruping. Many firms are realizing design's potential to drive their competitive position.
